title: Business Development Representative
description:
BDR / Appointment Setter

B2B prospecting pipeline development and qualified appointment setting



URGENT HIRING  Immediate or short-notice availability strongly preferred

Qore Team | Remote | Long-term independent contractor | UK business hours / flexible



We welcome applications from Philippines-based professionals. The gross contractor fee is negotiable according to relevant experience, capability and agreed scope.



About Qore Team

Qore Team provides outsourced marketing and sales-development services and is expanding into remote IT support. We help businesses build their pipelines, strengthen their marketing and deliver dependable services. We are growing our remote team, initially focused on the UK, with Australia in our wider plans.



The opportunity

We are looking for a proactive Business Development Representative who can start useful conversations, qualify prospects and book appointments that progress into real sales opportunities. You will research and contact prospective business customers, develop your own prospect pipeline and follow up consistently. Initial work supports Qore’s growth, with outsourced client campaigns included when agreed.

Works with the Sales Lead and Managing Director, with regular collaboration with marketing.

You will contribute directly to a growing business, help shape practical ways of working and see the impact of your work. Priorities may change as the business develops; we will agree achievable responsibilities and delivery expectations.



Key responsibilities



Prospect and build your pipeline

• Research target businesses and decision-makers using approved sources. Check contact accuracy, company fit and the reason for outreach.

• Carry out cold calling, personalised
 and LinkedIn outreach during agreed UK business hours. Tailor the message to the prospect’s situation.

• Ask clear qualification questions, identify relevant needs and buying roles, handle common objections and agree a sensible next step.

• Build and maintain a pipeline of new, engaged, nurturing and qualified prospects. Use follow-up sequences and dated next actions to develop opportunities over time.



Book and support qualified appointments

• Book meetings with suitable prospects against agreed qualification criteria. Confirm the purpose, attendees and time zone, and provide a concise handover.

• Manage confirmations, reminders, rescheduling and no-show follow-up professionally. Track meetings held as well as meetings booked.

• Record prospect needs, objections, commitments and relevant context in the CRM. Flag opportunities requiring a senior conversation.

• Maintain accurate CRM records, deal stages and task lists. Report progress, challenges and feedback so the team can improve targeting and messaging.

• Participate in coaching, call reviews and campaign tests. Apply feedback and take responsibility for improving the quality of your own work.

• Follow approved data-handling and outreach practices, respect opt-outs and protect client information. Use approved pricing and claims; escalate negotiations and contractual commitments.



Required skills and experience

• At least one year of relevant B2B outbound sales, sales-development or appointment-setting experience with measurable results.

• Confidence initiating cold calls, asking qualification questions, handling objections and maintaining a professional conversation with decision-makers.

• Practical ability to build and develop a prospect pipeline, including systematic nurturing and follow-up beyond the first contact.

• Experience using a CRM and maintaining accurate contact records, activity notes, opportunity stages and next actions.

• Very high written and spoken English proficiency, including clear telephone communication and professional
 writing with minimal editing.

• Good research skills, attention to detail, resilience and the ability to balance a consistent outreach workload with meeting quality.

• Coachability, dependable remote communication and ownership of commitments. You must be comfortable with changing campaign priorities.

• Willingness and reliable availability to work UK business hours, including agreed prime calling and appointment-setting periods.



Preferred experience

• Experience with outsourced sales companies, lead-generation agencies, BPOs or service providers running campaigns for multiple clients.

• Experience contacting UK or Australian businesses and selling or introducing B2B services, IT, marketing or SaaS.

• Familiarity with Zoho CRM, HubSpot or Salesforce, prospecting databases, diallers and
-sequencing tools.



What success looks like

Success means suitable prospects attend well-qualified meetings, handovers give the next person useful context, and promising contacts receive timely follow-up. We will review meetings held, qualification acceptance, show rates, opportunity progression and CRM accuracy alongside agreed outreach activity.



Availability and contractor terms

The role is full time, 8 hours per day. However, for the right candidate we can be flexible. Reliable availability during agreed UK business hours is essential, including adjustment when UK clocks change. Exact working windows and weekly hours will be agreed before the engagement begins. Tell us your earliest realistic start date and any availability constraints.

• This is a long-term independent contractor engagement. The gross fee, service scope, weekly hours, payment currency and invoicing terms will be agreed in writing. 

• You must independently manage and fund the legal, administrative, operational and financial responsibilities of providing your services: relevant registrations and permissions, tax returns and payments, bookkeeping, invoicing, applicable social contributions, insurance, healthcare and provision for time off.

• Provide and maintain your own suitable computer, headset, secure workspace, reliable internet and power, and practical backup arrangements. Include your normal equipment, connectivity, utilities, administration and operating costs in your quoted fee.

• No separate employee benefits, allowances or reimbursements are included unless agreed in writing or required by applicable law. Access to Qore or client systems and any campaign-specific costs will be agreed separately; do not incur expenditure on their behalf without approval.

• Organise your work independently to meet agreed outcomes, UK availability, confidentiality and security requirements. The written agreement and actual working arrangements must comply with applicable law; statutory rights and obligations cannot be waived by describing the engagement as contracting.



Apply now

Apply through this job board or
 recruitment at 
 with the role title in the subject line. Include:

• Your CV and a short explanation of your relevant outbound experience.

• One recent campaign example showing target market, service, timeframe, your outreach activity and meetings booked and held. Explain how meetings were qualified.

• Your CRM and prospecting-tool experience.

• Your earliest start date, notice period, UK-hours availability, expected gross monthly contractor fee in PHP, GBP or USD, included weekly hours and any separately proposed incentive terms.

The selection process may include an interview, a short prospecting role-play and a brief written outreach sample. Anonymise client information and do not send confidential material from previous organisations.



We are hiring urgently and reviewing applications as they arrive. Please make your availability and gross fee expectations clear in your application.

title: Paralegal / Legal Assistant
description:
Senior Legal Assistant / Paralegal

Full-Time • Remote • Long-Term (US Law Firm)



Sheil Law Firm, a Denver, Colorado law firm, is hiring one senior legal assistant/paralegal to work directly with the attorney.



The firm is one attorney and this seat. There is no layer of management and nowhere for work to hide. When clients trust the firm, it will often be because of something you did.



Most clients come to us on one of the hardest days of their lives: a death in the family, a child in trouble at school, or another life-changing event. They will not remember the legal work. They will remember whether someone answered, whether it was right, and whether it was done on time.



Because of that, two things matter more than anything on your résumé:



Responsiveness

When a client or the attorney contacts you during your shift, you acknowledge it promptly, even if the answer is simply:



"Received. Working on it. I'll have an update by 3."



Silence is the fastest way to fail here.



Ownership

You take tasks to completion without being chased. If you hit a roadblock, you raise it immediately. If a deadline is at risk, the attorney hears it from you first.



“I was waiting to hear back" is not a status update. Following up is part of the job.



Beyond those two principles, the standard is simple: clients feel taken care of, work is accurate, and records stay current. If it isn't in the system, it didn't happen.



We hire for temperament as much as skill. If you need every task assigned, prioritized, and explained before you begin, this role is probably not a fit.



What You Get Back



We are building this firm and want someone who wants to build it with us.



Your work will be visible and meaningful. In return, you get an attorney who backs you, pays on time, values initiative, and rewards contribution. We are looking for someone who wants a seat they can grow into and keep for years.



Practice Areas



The paralegal will primarily support matters involving:



- Estate planning (wills, trusts, powers of attorney, healthcare directives)

- Probate and estate administration

- Guardianships and conservatorships

- Guardian ad Litem representation

- Juvenile, family, and paternity matters

- Education and special-needs advocacy

- Elder law and adult-protection matters



The firm may also handle selected matters in other practice areas, including personal injury, civil litigation, administrative proceedings, and related legal matters. The ideal candidate is comfortable learning new processes and supporting work across multiple practice areas as the firm's needs evolve.



Responsibilities



Documents

- Prepare estate planning documents from attorney notes and firm templates

- Draft court filings, GAL reports, correspondence, and other legal documents for attorney review

- Proofread and redline documents for accuracy and consistency

- Assemble signing packages and coordinate witness/notary logistics



Client Management

- Respond to client communications the same day

- Conduct intake calls and gather missing information

- Keep clients informed about the status of their matter

- Escalate issues requiring attorney judgment



Records and Systems

- Maintain complete and current client files across firm systems

- Create and update matters, contacts, and client records

- Save and organize documents using firm naming conventions

- Perform conflict checks

- File and organize matter-related
s



Court and Matter Preparation

- Calendar hearings, deadlines, reviews, and signings

- Prepare hearing files and summaries

- Organize records, exhibits, and case history

- Research and summarize materials as assigned



Billing and Reporting

- Enter time and expenses

- Assist with monthly billing

- Provide regular status updates on active matters



Other Responsibilities

• Support firm operations, marketing, social media, technology, and special projects as needed

• Help improve systems, processes, and client experience

• Perform other duties reasonably related to the operation and growth of the firm



You May Be a Strong Fit If



- You notice details others miss

- You can manage dozens of active files without losing track of deadlines

- You learn processes quickly and retain them

- The attorney can assign you a task and stop thinking about it

- Your first drafts need editing, not rewriting

- You communicate clearly and professionally

- You stay calm under pressure and own mistakes quickly

- You are looking for a long-term position, not your next position



Requirements



- 3+ years of legal assistant or paralegal experience, **or** a Bachelor of Laws/JD and membership in good standing with the Philippine Bar

- College degree

- Excellent written and spoken English

- Ability to manage deadlines and files with minimal supervision



Only applicants meeting all requirements will be considered.



Preferred



- Experience in estate planning, probate, family law, juvenile law, personal injury, or litigation support

- Experience with HubSpot, ClickUp, Microsoft 365, Google Workspace, or legal practice-management software

- Comfort using AI tools for drafting, organization, and research



Schedule and Equipment



- Full-time, 40 hours per week

- Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. Mountain Time.  In Manila that is 10pm–7am (11pm–8am from November to mid-March). We are stating that plainly up front rather than discovering a mismatch in month two. The schedule is fixed, and this has to be your only job.

- This must be your only job

- Work is performed on a firm computer via remote desktop

- Reliable high-speed internet with a backup connection

- Backup power source

- Quiet private workspace

- Webcam, headset, and dual-monitor setup



Compensation



- $6.00-$8.00 USD per hour to start, depending on experience, qualifications, and interview performance

- Paid biweekly

- Compensation reviews at 6 and 12 months

- Paid US holidays

- Paid time off after probation



We are more interested in finding the right person than the cheapest person. Exceptional candidates may start at the upper end of the range.



Confidentiality



You will handle sensitive information, including estate planning documents, financial records, and information involving minors.



All work is performed under the supervision of a licensed US attorney on firm systems. A confidentiality agreement is required. This position does not involve providing legal advice.



How to Apply



 with the subject line:



**SENIOR LEGAL — [Your Name]**



Include:



1. Your résumé

2. Confirmation that you can work 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. Mountain Time and that this will be your only job

3. Your available start date and compensation expectations

4. Answers to the three questions below in your own words

5. A 60-second voice recording introducing yourself and explaining why this role fits you



Questions



a. A client
s asking for a status update on her case. You check the file, the CRM, and the
 history. Nothing has been recorded in three weeks, and the attorney is in court all day. What do you do, and what do you write back to her?



b. You realize a deadline on one of your files passed last week. What do you do in the next hour?



c. You open a new client's file to draft her trust and find no folder in Drive, no matter in the case system, and an intake sheet with two different dates of birth. Nobody has assigned you anything. What do you do?



Shortlisted candidates will complete a brief paid skills assessment before a final interview. We reply to every finalist.

title: Part-time Video Editor and Social Media Content Manager
description:
Remote | Part-Time | Long-Term Opportunity



We are Golden Vista Construction, a residential renovation company based in British Columbia, Canada. We specialize in kitchen, bathroom and condo renovations, and we are looking for a creative, reliable person to help us turn our raw video footage into professional social media content.



What we're looking for



We want someone who can take raw video footage and turn it into finished content with minimal direction.



Your responsibilities will include:



- Editing short-form videos for Instagram Reels,
 Reels and YouTube Shorts

- Editing occasional longer YouTube videos

- Creating strong hooks that grab attention in the first few seconds

- Adding captions, text overlays, transitions, B-roll and graphics

- Creating thumbnails and cover images

- Writing or improving social media captions and video descriptions

- Repurposing one piece of footage into content for multiple platforms

- Scheduling and publishing approved content

- Helping identify good content opportunities from the footage we provide

- Eventually helping us plan content ideas and maintain a consistent posting schedule



Our goal



We are not looking to simply post more content.



Quality is more important to us than quantity.



Initially, our target is approximately 4–5 polished pieces of content per week.



The owner will batch-record renovation videos and provide raw footage. Your job is to take that footage and turn it into professional, educational and engaging content.



Our content focuses on topics such as:



- Kitchen renovations

- Bathroom renovations

- Condo renovations

- Basement renovations

- Renovation costs

- Before-and-after transformations

- Common renovation mistakes

- DIY advice

- Product and material comparisons

- Frequently asked homeowner questions

- Behind-the-scenes construction

- Lessons learned on real projects



Who we're looking for



You should have:



- Strong video-editing skills

- Experience creating Reels, Shorts or TikTok-style videos

- A good understanding of pacing, storytelling and viewer retention

- The ability to create attention-grabbing hooks

- Basic graphic-design and thumbnail skills

- Good written English

- Good communication and reliability

- The ability to work independently

- Attention to detail



Experience with construction, home improvement, real estate, interior design or contractor content would be a major advantage, but it is not required.



You must be willing to learn our industry and our brand.



Editing style



Our content should feel:



Professional. Educational. Authentic. Clean.



We do not want excessive effects or editing that makes the videos feel gimmicky.



Our goal is to establish Golden Vista Construction as a trusted renovation expert while creating content that homeowners actually find useful.



Compensation



Starting budget: up to C$500 per month, depending on experience, ability and expected hours.



This will initially be a part-time position.



For the right person, we are interested in building a long-term working relationship, with the potential for the role and compensation to grow as our content program grows.



Paid Editing Test



We will shortlist approximately three candidates.



Each shortlisted candidate will receive:



- The same raw Golden Vista Construction video footage

- The same instructions

- The same deadline

- The same paid test fee



We want to see how you approach the footage creatively rather than simply judging you from your résumé.



We will evaluate:



1. The opening hook

2. Storytelling and pacing

3. Editing quality

4. Captions, graphics and visual presentation

5. Understanding of the message

6. Creativity

7. How much direction you require



How to Apply



Please send:



1. A short introduction about yourself

2. Your location and time zone

3. Your expected monthly compensation for this position

4. Approximately how many hours per week you can provide within that budget

5. Links to 3 examples of short-form videos you personally edited

6. One example of a longer YouTube video, if available

7. The editing software you normally use

8. Any experience you have with construction, renovation, home improvement, real estate or similar industries



Please also answer this question:



If we gave you 20 minutes of raw footage from a kitchen renovation, how would you turn it into multiple pieces of social media content?



At the beginning of your application, write the words:



GOLDEN STANDARDS

STRESS-FREE RENOVATIONS



This lets us know you read the entire job posting rather than sending a generic application.

title: Direct response - Video editor - Meta ads
description:
We're a multi-brand e-commerce team looking for a **video editor to own our
 ad creative long-term.**



**English required.**



### What the job actually is



We do direct-response performance marketing.



You'll be editing ads that have to **stop the scroll, hold attention and drive action**. We care about how the creative performs, not just whether the edit looks polished.



Pacing, cuts, sound, timing and hook construction matter a lot here. If you only want to receive clips, follow instructions and export videos without thinking about the message behind the ad, this probably isn't the right role.



A large share of our creative is AI-generated. You should already be comfortable working with formats such as:



* AI animation

* AI UGC / talking-head “yapper” style videos

* AI music-driven animation

* Direct-response UGC

* Short-form product ads



These formats evolve quickly, so we're looking for someone who actively follows what's working and keeps improving their creative judgment.



### You're a fit if you:



* Have real experience editing direct-response e-commerce ads

* Understand hooks, pacing, retention and sound design

* Are comfortable working with AI-generated video content

* Follow current
 ad formats and creative trends

* Want to understand **who the ad is for, what problem it solves and why the angle should work**

* Can follow a brief but also think for yourself

* Care about performance and want feedback on how your ads actually did

* Take the work seriously and want to build your skill set long-term



We're not looking for someone who needs every cut explained to them.



We are looking for someone who can develop stronger judgment over time and become increasingly valuable to the creative team.



### What you get



**Stable salary**



This is intended to be a long-term role, not occasional freelance work.



**Performance bonuses**



Strong creative work and consistently good execution are rewarded.



**Paid courses and training**



If we see that you're serious about improving, we'll invest in helping you get better.



**Growing responsibility**



Editors who develop strong creative judgment can grow into a **Creative Strategist** role and take on more responsibility over time.



If you want a comfortable editing job where you simply execute instructions, this probably isn't for you.



If you want to become very good at performance creative and be part of a team that tests constantly, learns fast and rewards improvement, apply below.



**Apply here:**

title: Marketing Specialist
description:
Marketing Specialist

Content creation social media SEO fundamentals and campaign delivery



URGENT HIRING

Qore Team | Remote | Long-term independent contractor | UK business hours / flexible

We welcome applications from Philippines-based professionals. The gross contractor fee is negotiable according to relevant experience, capability and agreed scope.



About Qore Team

Qore Team provides outsourced marketing and sales-development services and is expanding into remote IT support. We help businesses build their pipelines, strengthen their marketing and deliver dependable services. We are growing our remote team, initially focused on the UK, with Australia in our wider plans.



The opportunity

We need a capable marketing practitioner who can turn a brief into clear content, consistent social activity and measurable campaign delivery. You will support Qore’s own marketing and agreed client work, adapting content to different brands and audiences. This role suits someone who can write well, produce practical creative assets, maintain basic website content and work closely with sales.

Works with the Marketing Manager, Managing Director and sales team.

You will contribute directly to a growing business, help shape practical ways of working and see the impact of your work. Priorities may change as the business develops; we will agree achievable responsibilities and delivery expectations.



Key responsibilities



Create useful and persuasive content

• Plan and write website copy, landing pages, articles,
 campaigns, social posts, case studies and sales-support content suited to the audience and objective.

• Research topics and interview colleagues or clients to extract useful insights. Check facts, edit carefully and maintain the agreed brand voice.

• Create and adapt graphics, presentations and short-form video using tools such as Canva, Adobe applications or equivalent. Keep a consistent visual standard.

• Manage a content calendar from brief and draft through approval, publication and repurposing. Organise assets and use appropriate permissions and licences.



Manage social media and campaign execution

• Plan, schedule and publish platform-appropriate content, particularly for B2B LinkedIn activity and other channels relevant to each brief.

• Monitor comments, messages and engagement; respond within agreed boundaries and route sales enquiries or sensitive issues to the right person.

• Coordinate
 and content campaigns with sales outreach. Maintain consistent messaging and help turn campaign engagement into a useful follow-up.

• Track results, test messaging and formats, and recommend changes. Explain performance using relevant engagement, traffic, enquiry and conversion measures.



Apply SEO and website fundamentals

• Carry out basic keyword and search-intent research. Improve headings, page titles, metadata, internal links, image descriptions and content structure.

• Publish and update pages through a CMS such as WordPress or an equivalent platform. Check links, forms, mobile presentation and basic usability.

• Use tools such as Google Analytics and Search Console to understand performance and identify issues. Apply campaign tracking links where appropriate.

• Recognise when specialist development, design or technical SEO support is needed and prepare a clear brief. Advanced web development is outside the core scope.



Required skills and experience

• At least two years of relevant digital marketing experience, with a portfolio showing work you personally created and delivered.

• Very high written and spoken English proficiency. You must write accurate, persuasive UK-market content with minimal editing and communicate confidently with colleagues and clients.

• Strong copywriting, editing and content-repurposing skills across web,
 and social channels.

• Practical social media management experience, including planning, scheduling, publishing, community interaction and reporting.

• Sound fundamental knowledge of SEO, website content management and basic web usability.

• Ability to create professional visual content and make straightforward video edits using suitable design and editing tools.

• Working knowledge of analytics, campaign measurement and the difference between audience activity and meaningful business outcomes.

• Good organisation, attention to detail and the ability to manage several briefs, deadlines and brand voices without losing quality.

• Willingness and reliable availability to work UK business hours, with clear remote communication and ownership of agreed deliverables.



Preferred experience

• Experience in an outsourced marketing company, digital agency or another business delivering work for several clients.

• Experience marketing B2B services, MSP or IT services, professional services or SaaS to UK or Australian audiences.

• Experience with
 marketing, basic marketing automation, CRM handoffs or paid-campaign support. Any advanced paid-media responsibilities will be scoped separately.



What success looks like

Success means accurate, on-brand content is published on time, social channels are managed consistently and campaign reporting leads to practical improvements. We will agree measures around content quality, relevant engagement, search and website performance, enquiries and contribution to the sales pipeline.



Availability and contractor terms

The role is full time, 8 hours per day. However, for the right candidate we can be flexible. Reliable availability during agreed UK business hours is essential, including adjustment when UK clocks change. Exact working windows and weekly hours will be agreed before the engagement begins. Tell us your earliest realistic start date and any availability constraints.

• This is a long-term independent contractor engagement. The gross fee, service scope, weekly hours, payment currency and invoicing terms will be agreed in writing. Any incentive arrangement must be agreed separately.

• You must independently manage and fund the legal, administrative, operational and financial responsibilities of providing your services: relevant registrations and permissions, tax returns and payments, bookkeeping, invoicing, applicable social contributions, insurance, healthcare and provision for time off.

• Provide and maintain your own suitable computer, headset, secure workspace, reliable internet and power, and practical backup arrangements. Include your normal equipment, connectivity, utilities, administration and operating costs in your quoted fee.

• No separate employee benefits, allowances or reimbursements are included unless agreed in writing or required by applicable law. Access to Qore or client systems and any campaign-specific costs will be agreed separately; do not incur expenditure on their behalf without approval.

• Organise your work independently to meet agreed outcomes, UK availability, confidentiality and security requirements. The written agreement and actual working arrangements must comply with applicable law; statutory rights and obligations cannot be waived by describing the engagement as contracting.



Apply now

Apply through this job board or
 recruitment at 
 with the role title in the subject line. Include:

• Your CV and a portfolio of three to five relevant examples, including written content, social posts and visual work.

• For each example, explain your personal contribution, intended audience and any measurable outcome. Include one SEO or website-content improvement you delivered.

• The content, design, CMS, analytics and social-management tools you use confidently.

• Your earliest start date, notice period, UK-hours availability, expected gross monthly contractor fee in PHP, GBP or USD and included weekly hours.



The selection process may include an interview, portfolio discussion and a short content or campaign-planning exercise. Anonymise client information and do not send confidential material from previous organisations.



We are hiring urgently and reviewing applications as they arrive. Please make your availability and gross fee expectations clear in your application.



Learn more about Qore Team at

title: Mobile Game Playtester / QA - Gold Below (iPhone or Android, Paid Trial)
description:
Help us improve Gold Below, a dark-fantasy loot roguelike for mobile.



We're looking for playtesters who can tell us what feels fun, confusing, frustrating or broken on a real iPhone or Android phone. This is a short paid testing gig. Clear observations and useful bug reports matter more than finding a large number of bugs.



PAID TRIAL AND RATE

The initial trial is up to two paid hours total, including setup, gameplay, screen recording and a short written report. Please quote your hourly rate in USD. We will agree on your rate, scope, start time and test access before you begin. Reporting time is paid and included in the two-hour limit. No unpaid test or game purchase is required. Further sessions may be offered, but ongoing hours are not guaranteed.



WHAT TO TEST

- Start fresh and tell us whether the goal, controls and first few decisions are clear.

- Try combat, inventory management, loot and upgrades. Note confusing labels, hard-to-read text or awkward touch controls.

- Check save/resume by closing and reopening the game and by moving it to the background.

- Note crashes, freezes, visual problems, lost progress or performance issues.

- Give honest feedback on difficulty, pacing and whether you want to keep playing.



DELIVERABLES WITHIN THE TWO HOURS

- Record the first 15-20 minutes on your phone with spoken observations in English. Say what you expect, what confuses you and why you make decisions. No face camera or polished video editing is needed.

- Continue testing, then send a short report prioritizing your most useful findings.

- For each bug, include the phone model, OS and game version, steps to reproduce, expected versus actual behavior, and a screenshot or video timestamp when possible.

- Include a short summary of what worked, what did not and what you would improve first. There is no minimum bug count.



REQUIREMENTS

- Access to a real iPhone or Android phone, with permission to install a provided test build.

- Ability to record the phone screen with microphone audio.

- Clear written and spoken English for feedback.

- Familiarity with mobile games. Roguelike or turn-based game experience and previous QA work are useful but not essential for thoughtful playtesting.

- A stable connection to download the build and share your recording.



TO APPLY

Use the subject: Gold Below Playtester

1. List your phone model(s), OS version(s), and available screen-recording method.

2. State your hourly rate in USD and availability for a two-hour trial.

3. Briefly describe your testing experience and name two games you play, including what you like or dislike about them.

4. If you already have a bug report or narrated testing sample, share it. Do not create new unpaid work to apply.



We want candid product feedback; no public store review or positive rating is requested.

title: INDEPENDENT B2B SALES AGENT — COMMISSION ONLY
description:
Tech35 LLC | Lawrenceville, GA | Commercial technology infrastructure



Tech35 LLC sells and deploys business connectivity for commercial customers: business internet, backup/failover internet, Wi-Fi, network equipment, structured cabling, POS/camera/TV connectivity — with onsite activation handled by our installation techs.



THE MISSION



Turn Tech35 commercial opportunities into conversations, meetings, quotes, and closed business. We hand you qualified opportunities. You run the phones.



WHAT THE WORK IS



- Outbound B2B calling to business owners and managers, primarily in Metro Atlanta

- Discovery: ask good questions and understand what the business actually needs

- Objection handling and referral navigation: work past gatekeepers and reach the decision-maker

- Disciplined follow-up: work the queue, log your dispositions, and stay in front of every deal

- Work inside our Revenue OS: call queue, call logs, follow-ups, and performance tracking

- Use company telephony once provisioned

- You sell. Tech35 designs the network and deploys the install techs. No engineering or design work is part of this role.



WHAT WE NEED FROM YOU



- Real B2B phone sales ability: you are comfortable picking up the phone and selling to businesses

- Discovery and objection-handling skill

- Ability to navigate to decision-makers: gatekeepers do not stop you

- Follow-up discipline: you know deals close because someone followed up

- Independence: you manage your own day and your own pipeline

- Professional written and spoken communication

- A reliable computer and internet connection

- Comfort with measurable targets and performance tracking

- Comfort with commission-only, performance-based pay



WHAT WE DO NOT NEED



A degree. A polished resume. A big-name employer on your LinkedIn. If you can sell on the phone, we want to hear from you. A strong seller with an unimpressive resume is welcome here — your record of conversations, meetings, and closes is what counts.



COMPENSATION (commission only — no salary, no hourly)



- 25% of collected gross profit on Tech35-provided (house) leads

- 35% of collected gross profit on self-sourced business

- Carrier/connectivity deals: a defined share of the actual commission or residual Tech35 receives, for a defined period (set before any agreement is signed)

- Paid on collection — not on signature, not on promise

- Chargebacks apply if a customer cancels inside the clawback window

- This is a commission-only, performance-based role. No income is guaranteed and no earnings target is implied or promised. The compensation structure above is owner-approved under policy COMP-0001 v1 (ACTIVATED).



ENGAGEMENT



This is a commission-based independent agent engagement. The engagement classification will be reviewed with legal counsel before any agreement is signed. No legal classification determination is made or implied here.



TO APPLY



Apply at 
 with your name, phone, location, and a short summary of your B2B sales experience. Please do not contact our owner directly about this posting — applications go through the intake page only.



AI USE IN HIRING — DISCLOSURE



AI-assisted tools may be used in screening, assessments, and interviews. Your responses will be evaluated against job-related criteria only (never against protected characteristics). Final hiring decisions are made by a human, not by AI. If you need an accommodation or prefer an alternate evaluation path, say so in your application and we will provide one.

title: Digital Marketing Ads Specialist
description:
Digital Marketing Ads Specialist



Remote – Full Time | Philippines-based



AUD $2,200/month base salary + MRR commission bonus



Lead-Gen & E-Commerce Campaigns | Meta Ads & Google Ads Required | Client-Facing Role



Most marketing jobs promise flexibility.

But still track every hour, fill your calendar with meetings, and micromanage every task.

That's not how we work.

At Maximize Marketing, we're building a small team of high-performing marketers who want freedom, ownership, and the ability to earn more based on the value they create.



This is a remote-first role where you're trusted to manage your clients, drive results, and grow your income based on the success you help create.



No time tracking. No micromanagement. No pointless internal meetings. Just great work, great clients, and real ownership.

Read This First: This Is a Client-Facing Role



This is not a back-office ads role. You will be the person our clients speak to,
 and message every week about their results, their budgets and their strategy.



That means two things are non-negotiable:

• Excellent, native-level English, both written and spoken. You will write client
s and reports, and join client calls. Your English must be clear, confident, professional and polished, with no exceptions.

• Strong client-facing skills. You can explain performance simply, handle concerns calmly, and make clients feel like they have someone truly in their corner.

If your English is not at the highest level, or you prefer to work behind the scenes without speaking to clients, this role is not for you.



The Lifestyle

Imagine a role where:

• You work remotely and structure your day around productivity, not clock-watching

• You earn a base salary of AUD $2,200/month + commission based on the clients you manage and retain

• Your income grows as your client portfolio grows

• You're trusted to manage your workload without someone breathing down your neck

• You build long-term client relationships and see the impact of your work

We believe great marketers thrive when they're trusted to perform.

The only thing we ask in return: be extremely responsive, organised, and on top of everything. If a client messages you, they shouldn't be waiting days for a reply.



Who This Role Is Perfect For

This role is ideal for someone who:

• Has 1+ year of experience working in a digital marketing agency

• Has hands-on experience managing Meta Ads and Google Ads campaigns

• Has exceptional English and is confident communicating directly with clients by
, message and video call

• Is self-motivated and highly organised

• Thrives in a remote environment where accountability matters



You're the kind of person who:

• Doesn't wait to be told what to do

• Notices opportunities before clients do

• Takes pride in delivering strong results

• Communicates clearly, professionally and consistently

What You'll Be Doing

You'll take ownership of client accounts and help drive results through:

• Managing Meta Ads and Google Ads campaigns

• Optimising campaigns for lead generation and e-commerce growth

• Communicating directly with clients on performance, strategy and next steps, through written updates and calls

• Identifying opportunities to improve results

• Helping clients scale through smarter marketing

You'll play a direct role in client success and retention, which is why this role includes performance-based earning potential.



How You'll Earn

Base Salary: AUD $2,200/month 



Why Join Maximize Marketing?

We're a growing agency built on one simple philosophy: great people should be trusted to do great work.

What that means for you:

• Remote-first work environment

• Flexible working structure

• AUD $2,200/month base salary

• Real influence in a growing agency

• No micromanagement culture



We care about results, ownership, and great client relationships, not how many hours you're online.



Requirements

• Native or near-native English, spoken and written (essential). You will be assessed on this during the application process.

• Excellent client communication skills. You are confident and professional with clients.

• Minimum 1 year of experience in a digital marketing agency

• Hands-on experience with Meta Ads and Google Ads

• Experience with lead generation or e-commerce campaigns

• Highly organised and self-driven

• Comfortable working remotely with minimal supervision

• Based in the Philippines

Bonus if you have experience with:

• Landing page optimisation

• CRO insights

• Briefing designers/developers



The Kind of Person Who Will Thrive Here

Someone who:

• Wants freedom and responsibility

• Speaks and writes outstanding English and enjoys talking with clients

• Enjoys building long-term client relationships

• Is highly responsive and dependable

• Takes pride in delivering real results for clients

This role is not ideal for someone who needs constant supervision, prefers very structured corporate environments, or is not comfortable communicating directly with clients in English.

Application Process (Important)



To apply for this role, please include a short Loom video (2–4 minutes) answering the following questions. Applications without a Loom video will not be considered.



Your Loom is also how we assess your spoken English and how you come across to clients, so speak naturally and confidently. Start with a quick intro (your name and where you're based), then answer:

- In your last role, what was your KPI, and what did you actually achieve against it?

- Talk us through a Meta campaign that was underperforming. What did you do to turn it around?

- When you look at a landing page, what are the top 3–4 changes you've made to increase conversion rates?

- In this role you'll be managing about 50 clients. Each might have around 20 tasks per week, plus new ones that come up. How do you organise your week so nothing gets missed?

- What's your process for maximising client satisfaction?



Your Loom video doesn't need to be perfect. We're simply looking for clear communication, honesty, excellent English, and someone who takes initiative.



Please include the Loom link in your application.



💡 Tip: Candidates who record their Loom in one take tend to stand out the most.

title: Video Editor Meta Ads (AI focus)
description:
***Who We Are***



Brida is a fast-growing eCommerce brand built by founders who scaled the company to seven figures per month within just two months. We are now building our creative team and looking for people who want to grow with us and help shape the next phase of this company.



We move fast, we produce at volume, and we reward people who take their craft seriously. Right now we run only static ads. Video is the next big unlock in our ad account and we need the right person to help us capture that opportunity immediately.

If you want to edit ads that are seen by millions of people, build something from scratch, and grow into a creative leadership role, this is your seat.



***The Purpose of This Role***



The purpose of the Video Editor at Brida is to take ad briefs from our creative team and bring them to life through the power of video editing and AI video generation.



As our Video Editor you are responsible for the actual execution and finishing touches on every video ad we produce. Our success as a marketing team will rely directly on your ability to comprehend each ad concept, strategically assemble the pieces, and enhance the overall marketing message through your edits.



You understand that the smallest details make the biggest differences. A single cut, a perfectly timed transition, the right text overlay in the right frame, these are the details that separate an ad shown to millions from one shown to very few.

But this role goes beyond traditional editing. You will also be responsible for producing AI-generated video content that pushes our creative output into entirely new formats, realistic UGC-style product videos, Pixar-style character animations, and AI science and explainer animations. This is not optional. It is the core of why we are hiring right now.



***What You Will Do***



Onboarding

title: Clinical Support Coordinator (Remote, Philippines)
description:
About the role

We are a growing Australian mental health clinic network. We provide specialist treatment for people with depression, anxiety, chronic pain and PTSD, as well as structured mental health and brain health assessments. This role does the careful, structured work around each assessment and treatment course: gathering information, keeping patients on their follow-up schedule, and preparing files and drafts. That frees our Australian clinicians to spend their time on clinical judgement and sign-off. This is a trial role.



Role details

- Function: Supports the treatment delivery and patient follow-up stages of the patient journey, and our mental health and brain health assessments

- Reports to: CEO for now, and the Medical Director once appointed

- Clinical supervision: The Australian supervising clinician (GP, nurse practitioner or psychiatrist) for each patient. They make every clinical decision and sign off every report

- Works closely with: Patient Flow Lead, the in-clinic treatment team, and finance, billing and admin

- Location: Remote, Philippines

- Engagement: Full-time contractor

- Hours: Monday to Friday, 6:00 am to 3:00 pm Philippine time. Patients are in two time zones, an hour apart from October to April

- Probation: 3 months, reviewed against the KPIs below



Scope of practice in this role

Australian law requires anyone providing a health service to patients in Australia, including by telehealth, to be registered with the Australian Health Practitioner Regulation Agency (Ahpra). Unless you hold Ahpra registration, you will work in a clinical support role under Australian clinicians, and you will not practise as a nurse for our patients. In practice:

- You introduce yourself to patients as a clinical support coordinator working with the named Australian clinician, not as their nurse

- You follow structured templates and protocols. Clinical assessment, interpretation, diagnosis, treatment decisions and advice are made by the Australian clinician

- Every summary, letter and report you prepare is a draft until the Australian clinician reviews and signs it

- If you hold or gain Ahpra registration, the scope of this role will be reviewed with you



Key responsibilities



Mental health and brain health assessments

- Run the structured intake by video using the fixed template for each assessment type: mental health history and current symptoms, or brain health history, lifestyle and risk factors

- Send the self-report questionnaires, check they are complete and score them

- Book pathology where the assessment requires it, and chase results until the file is complete

- Prepare the assessment file and draft the patient summary and GP letter for the Australian clinician to review, edit and sign

- Cognitive testing is done by the Australian clinician unless the instrument's licence allows trained support staff to administer it



Treatment support and follow-up

- Pre-treatment calls: confirm forms, consent paperwork, arrangements and questionnaires are complete before the first treatment day

- Post-treatment follow-up on schedule: week-2 check-in calls, and preparing the week-6, month-4, month-6 and month-12 review appointments

- Monitor symptom questionnaires sent by SMS. Any result that crosses a threshold goes to the Australian clinician within one business day, and the same day for any risk item

- Follow up patients who miss two questionnaires in a row

- Prepare discharge paperwork and draft GP letters from the treatment record for clinician signature



Records and research data

- Keep every patient file complete and accurate in our practice software and other systems, on the same day

- Enter research data for consenting participants accurately, following the study protocol



What this role does not do

- Give clinical advice, make diagnoses, or d
 whether someone is suitable for treatment

- Interpret pathology, cognitive tests or questionnaire results for the patient

- Change treatment, medication or follow-up plans

- Handle billing or payments



Key performance indicators

- Assessment turnaround (headline): 5 business days or fewer from the patient's appointment to a report signed by the clinician. Your part is having the file and drafts ready within 2 business days. Reviewed weekly

- Follow-up on schedule: 95% or more of week-2 calls and booked reviews completed on time. Reviewed weekly

- Questionnaire alerts: 100% of threshold alerts passed to the clinician within 1 business day. Reviewed weekly

- Risk escalation: 100% of risk disclosures handed to an Australian clinician the same day. Reviewed every case

- Draft quality: 80% or more of drafts signed with only minor edits by month 3. Reviewed monthly

Targets are a starting point and will be reviewed with you as we learn what is realistic.



Safety and escalation

Some of our patients are very unwell. If a patient mentions self-harm, su
, or feeling unsafe, or scores above 0 on PHQ-9 item 9:

1. Stay with them, stay calm and listen.

2. Give them the Australian crisis contacts: 000 in an emergency, and Lifeline on 13 11 14.

3. Call the on-duty Australian clinician straight away, while the patient is still on the line if you can.

4. Record what happened in the patient file and flag it. Do not end your shift until the handover has been confirmed.



A typical week (Philippine time)

Each day starts by checking questionnaire alerts that came in overnight.

- Monday: Questionnaire alerts and weekend messages. Week-2 check-in calls. 15-minute huddle with the Patient Flow Lead at 8:00 am

- Tuesday: Two assessment intakes by video (mental health or brain health). Pathology booked where needed. Weekly numbers ready for the KPI review

- Wednesday: Assessment files prepared and drafts sent for sign-off. Pre-treatment calls for next week's patients

- Thursday: Two more assessment intakes. Follow-up on missed questionnaires. Review appointments prepared

- Friday: Discharge paperwork and GP letter drafts. Chase outstanding results. Records tidied and next week planned



Privacy and confidentiality

- You will handle Australian health information, which is protected under Australia's Privacy Act 1988. You will sign a confidentiality agreement and complete privacy training before you start

- Work only in our systems, in a private room where no one else can see or hear the patient. Do not save, download, photograph or forward patient information

- Research data is handled only as the approved study protocol allows



Your first 90 days

- Days 1 to 30: Trained on templates, questionnaires, systems and the safety procedure. Observe assessments and follow-up calls, then run them with review

- Days 31 to 60: Running follow-up calls and questionnaire monitoring independently. Preparing assessment files and drafts

- Days 61 to 90: Meeting the turnaround and follow-up targets each week. Drafts mostly signed with minor edits. Probation review



Essential

- A healthcare background, such as nursing, psychology or allied health

- At least 2 years working directly with patients, ideally in mental health

- Experience speaking with patients by video or phone

- Excellent spoken and written English, including clear clinical writing

- Reliable high-speed internet (at least 25 Mbps) with a backup connection and backup power, a quiet private room, a headset and webcam, and your own computer



Highly valued

- Nursing experience, especially in mental health or psychiatric care. A current Philippine PRC licence is a strong advantage



Desirable

- Experience working with Australian, US or UK patients

- Experience with standardised assessment tools or cognitive screening

- Experience with practice software or electronic medical records



How to apply

Please send the following to 
 address] by [day, date, time Philippine time]:

- Your CV, and your PRC licence number if you hold one

- A 60 to 90 second voice recording. Imagine a patient has just told you on a video call that they have been feeling hopeless for weeks. Tell us what you would say and do

- A short written summary (no more than 150 words) of a mental health patient you have cared for or supported, with no identifying details

- Your internet speed test result, your monthly rate, and when you could start



Use the subject line "Clinical Support Coordinator, [your name]". Shortlisted applicants will be invited to a video interview and a short practical task.

description:
Real Estate Lead Manager / ISA – Inbound & Outbound Lead Follow-Up

Xpert Realty Group is looking for a dependable, organized, and confident Real Estate Lead Manager / Inside Sales Assistant (ISA) to manage incoming real estate leads, conduct outbound prospecting, consistently follow up with prospects, and schedule qualified appointments for our broker and agents.

This is not a general administrative VA position. Your primary responsibility will be helping us make sure no legitimate real estate opportunity falls through the cracks.

You will work primarily inside Lofty CRM and serve as the first point of contact for many new buyer and seller leads.

What You’ll Do

- Monitor Lofty during your assigned work hours for new inbound leads

- Respond quickly to new leads by phone, text, and

- Call and follow up with older leads already in our database

- Make outbound prospecting calls to potential sellers

- Work buyer and seller internet leads

- Contact expired listings, FSBOs, absentee owners, distressed-property prospects, cash-offer leads, and other seller opportunities

- Qualify leads by determining their motivation, timeline, property situation, and real estate needs

- Schedule qualified appointments for the broker or assigned agent

- Immediately escalate hot or time-sensitive opportunities

- Follow our scripts and processes while still sounding natural and conversational

- Professionally handle common objections

- Accurately document every meaningful conversation in Lofty

- Update lead status, tags, notes, follow-up dates, and tasks

- Place leads into the appropriate follow-up or nurture process

- Continue nurturing prospects who are not ready today but may buy or sell later

- Help maintain a clean, organized CRM database

- Attend training, coaching, and roleplay sessions

- Track daily activity and weekly results

Inbound Lead Responsibilities

Speed-to-lead is important to this position.

When a new lead enters Lofty during your assigned working hours, you will be expected to quickly begin the appropriate contact process.

This may include:

Call → Text →
 → Qualify → Document → Schedule or Nurture

You should be comfortable communicating with people who have recently requested information as well as prospects who may require multiple follow-up attempts before responding.

Outbound Lead Responsibilities

You will also proactively contact prospects who have not recently requested information.

These may include:

- Older CRM leads

- Expired listings

- FSBOs

- Absentee owners

- Tired landlords

- Pre-foreclosure/distressed-property leads

- Cash-offer prospects

- Homeowners identified through prospecting lists

You must be comfortable making outbound calls and hearing “no” without becoming discouraged.

What We Are Looking For

You should be:

- Reliable

- Persistent

- Organized

- Coachable

- Comfortable speaking with U.S. homeowners

- Confident on the telephone

- Professional and friendly

- Detail-oriented

- Comfortable with repetitive follow-up

- Able to work independently

- Able to follow a defined process

- Comfortable being measured by results

Strong spoken and written English is required.

You do not need an American accent, but homeowners must be able to clearly and comfortably understand you.

CRM Discipline Is Extremely Important

Every lead interaction should result in accurate CRM documentation.

We expect meaningful notes—not simply:

“Called lead.”

A good CRM note should explain what happened and what should happen next.

For example:

“Seller may relocate in approximately 3 months. Home needs some repairs. Interested in learning retail value and may consider a cash offer. Follow up Nov. 15.”

Technical Requirements

You must have:

- Reliable computer

- Minimum 8 GB RAM; 16 GB preferred

- Stable high-speed internet

- Backup internet connection or mobile hotspot

- Quality noise-canceling headset

- Webcam

- Quiet professional workspace

- Backup plan for internet or power interruptions

Preferred Experience

Previous experience with real estate, appointment setting, telemarketing, lead generation, inside sales, or customer service is strongly preferred.

Experience with any of the following is a plus:

- Lofty / Chime

- Follow Up Boss

- kvCORE

- GoHighLevel

- BoomTown

- HubSpot

- Salesforce

- Real estate investing

- Real estate wholesaling

- Seller lead generation

- Buyer internet leads

- Expired listings

- FSBO prospecting

- Cash-offer campaigns

Lofty experience is preferred but not required. We can train the right candidate.

Schedule

Part-Time – 20 hours per week

Approximately:

4 hours per day / 5 days per week

You must be available during agreed U.S. Eastern Time working hours.

There may be an opportunity for increased hours and responsibility based on performance.

Compensation

$5 USD per hour + performance-based bonus opportunities

Long-term growth opportunities are available for a candidate who consistently performs well.

How Performance Will Be Measured

We care about more than simply how many hours you work.

Performance may include:

- Calls made

- Leads contacted

- Meaningful conversations

- Speed-to-lead

- Follow-up completion

- Qualified leads generated

- Appointments scheduled

- Appointments held

- CRM accuracy

- Lead-to-client conversion

Our initial goal is approximately 4 qualified appointments per week, although expectations may be adjusted based on lead volume, list quality, and campaign type.

How to Apply

Please include all of the following:

1. Briefly describe your previous calling, sales, ISA, or lead-generation experience.

2. Tell us whether you have previously worked with a real estate agent, brokerage, investor, wholesaler, mortgage company, or property management company.

3. List the CRMs and dialers you have used.

4. Tell us your current internet speed and your backup internet plan.

5. Provide a link to a 60–90 second voice recording introducing yourself and explaining why you would be comfortable handling both inbound and outbound real estate leads.

6. Tell us your available working hours in U.S. Eastern Time.

7. Tell us whether you currently work for any other clients and approximately how many hours per week.

IMPORTANT: Begin your application with the words:

FOLLOW-UP MATTERS

This lets us know that you read the complete job posting and can follow instructions.

We are looking for someone interested in becoming a long-term member of our team, not simply completing short-term tasks.

The right person will eventually become an important part of our lead-management system—responding to new opportunities, nurturing existing leads, identifying motivated prospects, and making sure the right opportunities reach our broker and agents at the right time.

title: Senior Credit Repair Specialist / Dispute & Client Progress Manager
description:
# Senior Credit Repair Specialist / Dispute & Client Progress Manager



**Company:** Opulent Credit  

**Position:** Remote Credit Repair Specialist  

**Experience Level:** Experienced — NOT Entry Level  

**Employment:** Part-Time to Start, With Opportunity to Grow  

**Industry:** Credit Repair / Consumer Credit / Financial Services



## ABOUT OPULENT CREDIT



Opulent Credit is a growing U.S.-based credit restoration and financial services company.



We are looking for an experienced, **RESULTS-DRIVEN Credit Repair Specialist** who can take ownership of the backend credit repair process and help us deliver an organized, professional, results-focused experience for every client.



This is NOT simply a data-entry or letter-generation position.



We need someone who understands credit reports, dispute processing, client file management, documentation, follow-up cycles, and progress tracking — and who can manage client accounts with minimal supervision.



## RESULTS MATTER HERE



We are specifically looking for a **results-driven specialist**.



Our clients hire us because they want meaningful improvement in their credit profiles. When inaccurate, incomplete, unverifiable, duplicate, outdated, or otherwise legitimately disputable negative information is reporting, we expect our specialist to pursue the appropriate correction or deletion diligently and professionally.



**We do not guarantee deletions.**



We do not expect you to dispute accurate information without a legitimate basis, fabricate claims, misuse identity-theft procedures, or promise outcomes that cannot legally or ethically be guaranteed.



However, when a client is **rightfully owed a correction or deletion**, we expect you to know how to identify the issue, build the appropriate dispute strategy, provide supporting documentation when available, follow up correctly, evaluate the response, and continue pursuing legitimate remedies when warranted.



Simply sending a dispute and waiting is **not enough**.



We want someone who asks:



- Why did this item remain?

- Was the dispute sufficiently specific?

- What documentation supports the client's position?

- What exactly did the bureau or furnisher investigate?

- Did the information change?

- Is the reporting now accurate and complete?

- Is an additional legitimate dispute warranted?

- Should the matter be escalated through another appropriate channel?

- What is the strongest compliant next step for this client?



You should be **persistent without being reckless**.



We want measurable results — including legitimate deletions, corrections, updated account information, removal of inaccurate personal information, resolution of reporting errors, and documented improvement across client files.



## YOUR PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITY



Your job is to keep every Opulent Credit client moving forward.



You should know:



- What stage every client is currently in

- What has already been disputed

- What changed on each bureau

- What was deleted, corrected, verified, or remains unresolved

- When the next action is due

- What strategy should be used next

- What documents or information are still needed

- Which cases require management attention



No client should ever sit untouched because their file was forgotten.



## CREDIT REPORT ANALYSIS



You will review and analyze consumer credit reports from:



- Experian

- Equifax

- TransUnion



You must be able to identify potentially:



- Inaccurate information

- Incomplete information

- Duplicate reporting

- Incorrect balances

- Incorrect account statuses

- Incorrect payment histories

- Incorrect dates

- Incorrect personal information

- Mixed-file information

- Unauthorized or questionable inquiries

- Collections

- Charge-offs

- Late payments

- Repossessions

- Bankruptcies

- Other potentially disputable reporting issues



You must understand the difference between legitimately disputable information and accurate information that should not be misrepresented as inaccurate.



## DISPUTE PROCESSING



You will be responsible for managing dispute cycles from beginning to end.



Responsibilities include:



- Reviewing each client's complete credit profile

- Developing an appropriate dispute strategy based on the client's actual report

- Preparing accurate and individualized disputes

- Processing bureau disputes

- Preparing appropriate furnisher/creditor disputes when applicable

- Managing personal-information disputes

- Uploading supporting documentation

- Maintaining copies of correspondence

- Tracking dispute submission dates

- Tracking expected response dates

- Reviewing bureau and furnisher responses

- Determining appropriate next steps

- Preparing subsequent dispute rounds when warranted

- Preventing unnecessary duplicate or repetitive disputes

- Escalating unusual or complicated cases to management



We do NOT want someone blindly generating the same dispute letter for every client.



Every client file must be reviewed individually.



## KNOWLEDGE EXPECTATIONS



You should have practical working knowledge of credit reporting and consumer protection requirements, including:



- Fair Credit Reporting Act (FCRA)

- Fair Debt Collection Practices Act (FDCPA)

- FACTA

- Consumer reporting agency dispute procedures

- Furnisher dispute procedures

- Reasonable investigation requirements

- Reinvestigation procedures

- Maximum possible accuracy principles

- Identity theft procedures

- Debt validation concepts

- Credit reporting timelines

- Deletion/reinsertion procedures

- CFPB complaint procedures

- Metro 2 reporting concepts



You do NOT need to be an attorney.



However, you must understand how these laws and standards affect legitimate credit reporting disputes and know when something should be escalated rather than making unsupported legal claims.



## CLIENT FILE MANAGEMENT



Organization is extremely important.



Every client file should contain clear documentation showing:



- Current credit profile

- Original negative items

- Current negative items

- Dispute history

- Dispute dates

- Dispute rounds

- Letters/documents submitted

- Bureau responses

- Creditor/furnisher responses

- Items deleted

- Items corrected

- Items verified

- Items remaining

- New negative items

- Score changes when available

- Required client documents

- Next recommended action

- Next follow-up date



Someone should be able to open a client's account and immediately understand exactly what has happened with that client.



## CLIENT PROGRESS REPORTING



This is one of the MOST IMPORTANT parts of this position.



Management must have visibility into the entire client base.



You will provide regular progress reports showing each client's status.



Reports should include:



**Client Name**  

**Current Dispute Round**  

**Date Last Action Was Taken**  

**Bureaus Worked**  

**Items Challenged**  

**Items Deleted/Corrected**  

**Items Remaining**  

**Score Changes, If Available**  

**Responses Received**  

**Current Status**  

**Next Recommended Action**  

**Next Action Date**  

**Documents Needed From Client**  

**Issues / Escalations / Notes**



We expect proactive reporting.



Management should NOT have to repeatedly ask:



"What's going on with this client?"



You should already know.



## WEEKLY OPERATIONS REPORT



You will also provide management with a weekly overview containing:



- Total active clients

- Clients currently in active dispute cycles

- New clients onboarded

- Disputes completed that week

- Bureau/furnisher responses received

- Total deletions/corrections recorded

- Clients awaiting responses

- Clients requiring another dispute round

- Clients waiting on documentation

- Stalled or problematic accounts

- Accounts requiring management attention

- Upcoming deadlines/actions



Accuracy is more important than making numbers look impressive.



## CLIENT ONBOARDING & QUALITY CONTROL



For new clients, you may be responsible for:



- Reviewing onboarding information

- Verifying required documents are present

- Confirming credit monitoring/report access

- Organizing client documentation

- Completing an initial credit audit

- Recording baseline credit information

- Identifying initial dispute opportunities

- Creating the initial case strategy

- Flagging missing or conflicting information before processing



Before anything is submitted, you are expected to perform quality control.



Names, addresses, account numbers, bureaus, dates, documents, and dispute reasons must be checked for accuracy.



## SOFTWARE



Experience with credit repair platforms is strongly preferred.



Experience with any of the following is valuable:



- DisputeFox

- Credit Repair Cloud

- Dispute Panda

- Client Dispute Manager

- GoHighLevel or other CRM platforms

- Credit monitoring/report platforms

- Google Sheets / Excel

- Google Drive

- Project-management systems



If you have experience with DisputeFox specifically, please mention it prominently in your application.



## DATA SECURITY & CONFIDENTIALITY



You will work with sensitive consumer information.



You must:



- Maintain strict confidentiality

- Follow company security procedures

- Never download or share client information unnecessarily

- Never use client information outside authorized company systems

- Protect passwords and account credentials

- Immediately report suspected security issues

- Follow company policies regarding access to client data



Discretion and trustworthiness are mandatory.



## PERFORMANCE EXPECTATIONS



We are looking for someone who is:



- **Results-driven**

- Extremely organized

- Detail-oriented

- Persistent

- Resourceful

- Reliable

- Proactive

- Analytical

- Consistent

- Deadline-driven

- Comfortable managing multiple client files

- Able to work independently

- Able to communicate problems before they become emergencies



We are not measuring performance solely by the number of letters sent.



We care about **case progression, legitimate deletions and corrections, accuracy, proper follow-up, documentation quality, turnaround time, and keeping clients moving toward the strongest credit profile legitimately available to them.**



You should be capable of managing a growing client caseload without allowing quality to decline.



## REQUIRED EXPERIENCE



Applicants should have:



- 2+ years of hands-on credit repair/dispute processing experience preferred

- Experience analyzing all three major credit bureaus

- Experience managing multiple client dispute cycles

- Experience reviewing bureau responses

- Experience tracking deletions, corrections, and account changes

- Strong understanding of FCRA/FDCPA and credit reporting procedures

- Excellent written English

- Excellent organizational skills

- Strong attention to detail

- Reliable computer and internet connection



This is NOT an entry-level position.



We prefer someone who can enter the company and contribute quickly rather than requiring extensive training on basic credit repair.



## BONUS EXPERIENCE



Strong candidates may also have experience with:



- CFPB complaints

- Furnisher disputes

- Identity theft documentation

- Secondary consumer reporting agencies

- LexisNexis

- Innovis

- SageStream

- CoreLogic

- Advanced credit report auditing

- Funding-readiness credit analysis

- Business credit

- Credit optimization



## WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE



A successful Credit Repair Specialist at Opulent Credit makes our backend run smoothly.



Client files are organized.



Disputes go out on schedule.



Responses are reviewed promptly.



Results are documented.



**Legitimate opportunities for deletions and corrections are pursued thoroughly.**



When the first attempt does not resolve a legitimate reporting issue, the specialist analyzes why and determines the appropriate next step rather than simply giving up.



Next actions are already planned.



Management always knows where clients stand.



Clients don't fall through the cracks.



And as our client base grows, our operational quality grows with it.



## HOW TO APPLY



Please send:



1. Your resume/CV

2. Number of years working specifically in credit repair

3. Credit repair software you have used

4. Approximate number of client files you have managed simultaneously

5. A description of your normal dispute workflow from onboarding through subsequent rounds

6. A sample of how you track/report client progress

7. Examples of legitimate deletions/corrections you have achieved, with ALL consumer personal information removed/redacted

8. Your experience with FCRA, FDCPA, Metro 2 concepts, CFPB complaints, and furnisher disputes

9. Your expected hourly/monthly compensation

10. Your weekly availability



**IMPORTANT APPLICATION TEST:**



At the very top of your application, write:



**OPULENT STANDARD**



Then answer this scenario:



*A client's first dispute round has returned. Two accounts were deleted, one account was corrected, three accounts were verified with no changes, and one bureau has not yet responded.*



Briefly explain:



- What you would document

- What you would report to management

- What you would review before determining the next action

- How you would approach the three verified accounts

- How you would make sure this client does not fall through the cracks



Applications that do not follow these instructions may not be considered.



We are looking for a **long-term, results-driven team member** who wants to grow with the company — not someone looking to complete the bare minimum.

description:
META ADS SPECIALIST - Paid Social for Car Tech Brand (Long-term, Monthly Retainer)



ABOUT US

We run a fast-growing e-commerce brand selling smartphone integration modules (wireless Apple CarPlay / Android Auto) for BMW, Mercedes and Audi. We sell across the US, UK and Europe and run 5-figure monthly ad spend on Meta. The founder runs every campaign personally - you start as his right hand on the account, and the role grows from there.



THE JOB

You start as a helper on the account: daily monitoring, uploading creatives, building ad sets to our specs, keeping tracking healthy. Show results and you grow into running the monitoring fully, with your own test campaigns and budget.



- Daily account check with a short read: what moved, what to watch, what you recommend and why

- Prepare launches: upload creatives, build ad sets to our specs, name things properly

- Fix and maintain tracking health: Events Manager, Conversions API, deduplication. This is your first real project and we measure it against our real sales numbers

- Audit our Meta ad account and tell us what we're missing - this is how you get hired

- Weekly summary: results, learnings, what to test next



We provide EVERYTHING: full account history, our testing doctrine and decision rules, proven creatives and scripts, past performance data, and a founder who answers fast.



The hard part of this job is not launching campaigns. title: Full-Time Video Editor (Ecom Ads)

BONUS: You've been through courses like EcomTalent.

What makes them buy.

Eight ads.



First week.



Tripled revenue.
