title: Sales Team lead
description:
Senior BDR / Campaign Lead / Sales Lead

Hands-on outbound sales and core team management responsibilities



URGENT HIRING  Immediate or short-notice availability strongly preferred

Qore Team | Remote | Long-term independent contractor | UK business hours

We welcome applications from Philippines-based professionals. The gross contractor fee is negotiable according to relevant experience, capability and agreed scope.



About Qore Team

Qore Team provides outsourced marketing and sales-development services and is expanding into remote IT support. We help businesses build their pipelines, strengthen their marketing and deliver dependable services. We are growing our remote team, initially focused on the UK, with Australia in our wider plans.



The opportunity

We need an experienced business development professional who can build a repeatable outbound pipeline while managing and improving a small sales team. You will personally prospect and nurture opportunities, coach junior colleagues, and take responsibility for campaign execution and quality. Team management is a core requirement. The initial priority is Qore’s own growth, with responsibility for outsourced client campaigns as agreed.

Reports to the Managing Director. Leads and develops the sales-development team and works closely with marketing.

You will contribute directly to a growing business, help shape practical ways of working and see the impact of your work. Priorities may change as the business develops; we will agree achievable responsibilities and delivery expectations.



Key responsibilities

Build and develop sales pipelines

• Define target customer profiles, research accounts and decision-makers, and build accurate, prioritised prospect lists.

• Run outbound activity through cold calling, personalised
 and LinkedIn. Qualify needs, business fit, buying process and realistic timing; progress prospects to an appropriate next step.

• Build nurture sequences for prospects who are not ready to buy. Maintain clear next actions, ownership and follow-up dates so viable opportunities are not lost.

• Create and improve CRM stages, qualification criteria, handoff standards and pipeline reports. Review ageing opportunities, conversion rates and forecast assumptions.



Manage and develop the team

• Set clear campaign priorities and individual responsibilities. Manage the day-to-day delivery of junior BDRs and appointment setters alongside your own agreed sales activity.

• Onboard and train colleagues, run call reviews and role-plays, provide specific feedback, and document coaching actions and progress.

• Identify performance gaps early, agree improvement actions and escalate persistent issues to the Managing Director. Build usable playbooks, scripts and quality standards.



Lead campaigns and coordinate delivery

• Translate a brief into an outbound plan covering audience, messaging, channels, sequencing, workload and reporting. Test changes and explain what the evidence shows.

• Coordinate with marketing on messaging, content, lead quality and campaign feedback. Keep Qore and client campaign data, promises and priorities clearly separated.

• Provide concise progress reports and explain risks, blockers and recommended improvements. Support prospect handover and client campaign reviews where required.

• Use prospect data responsibly, respect opt-outs and follow approved outreach and security requirements. Pricing, contracts and final commercial commitments remain with the Managing Director.



Required skills and experience

• At least three years of relevant B2B outbound sales or business development experience, including at least one year managing or directly coaching a small sales-development team.

• Evidence of personally generating qualified meetings and opportunities, with clear reporting periods and an explanation of your contribution versus the team’s results.

• Demonstrated ability to build a pipeline from research through prospecting, qualification, nurturing and sales handover.

• Confident cold calling, objection handling and consultative questioning, plus excellent personalised outreach writing.

• Practical experience with a CRM such as Zoho CRM, HubSpot or Salesforce, and prospect research, sequencing and reporting tools.

• Very high written and spoken English proficiency. You must be able to coach colleagues, lead client conversations and write clear professional messages with minimal editing.

• A hands-on leadership style, sound judgement, reliable follow-through and the ability to prioritise in an early-stage business.

• Willingness and reliable availability to work UK business hours, including agreed prime calling and outreach periods.



Preferred experience

• Experience in an outsourced sales provider, lead-generation agency, BPO, MSP or other company delivering services for multiple clients.

• Experience selling B2B professional services, marketing, IT, managed services or SaaS into UK or Australian markets.

• Experience establishing sales processes or improving an underperforming campaign in a small or growing business.



What success looks like

Success means a well-managed team, accurate pipeline visibility, consistent follow-up and a growing flow of held, qualified meetings and accepted opportunities. We will agree targets based on campaign maturity, audience and resources. Meeting quality, conversion and coaching outcomes matter alongside activity levels.



Availability and contractor terms

Reliable availability during agreed UK business hours is essential, including adjustment when UK clocks change. Exact working windows and weekly hours will be agreed before the engagement begins. Tell us your earliest realistic start date and any availability constraints.

• This is a long-term independent contractor engagement. The gross fee, service scope, weekly hours, payment currency and invoicing terms will be agreed in writing. Any incentive arrangement must be agreed separately.

• You must independently manage and fund the legal, administrative, operational and financial responsibilities of providing your services: relevant registrations and permissions, tax returns and payments, bookkeeping, invoicing, applicable social contributions, insurance, healthcare and provision for time off.

• Provide and maintain your own suitable computer, headset, secure workspace, reliable internet and power, and practical backup arrangements. Include your normal equipment, connectivity, utilities, administration and operating costs in your quoted fee.

• No separate employee benefits, allowances or reimbursements are included unless agreed in writing or required by applicable law. Access to Qore or client systems and any campaign-specific costs will be agreed separately; do not incur expenditure on their behalf without approval.

• Organise your work independently to meet agreed outcomes, UK availability, confidentiality and security requirements. The written agreement and actual working arrangements must comply with applicable law; statutory rights and obligations cannot be waived by describing the engagement as contracting.



Apply now

Apply through this job board or
 recruitment at 
 with the role title in the subject line. Include:

• Your CV and a brief explanation of why this hands-on leadership role suits you.

• One recent campaign example: service sold, target market, channels, timeframe, personal results and team results. Include meetings held, qualified opportunities or revenue where you can substantiate them.

• The number of people you managed or coached and one specific example of improved performance.

• Your earliest start date, notice period, UK-hours availability, expected gross monthly contractor fee in PHP, GBP or USD, included weekly hours and any separately proposed incentive terms.



The selection process may include an interview, a short outbound role-play and discussion of a pipeline or team-coaching plan. Anonymise client information and do not send confidential material from previous organisations.



We are hiring urgently and reviewing applications as they arrive. Please make your availability and gross fee expectations clear in your application.



Learn more about Qore Team at 
.

The platform is currently run by a core engineering team. You'll own real parts of the system end to end — write it, ship it, watch it run.



The work is broad: REST APIs and React one day, a camera that won't stream the next, a router dropping its VPN the day after. There's no separate devops or QA team. If that sounds like a mess, it's not for you. If it sounds interesting, keep reading.



Stack



Python 3.12 / FastAPI, React, MariaDB, self-hosted Linux (systemd, nginx), WireGuard, 4G routers, IP cameras over RTSP and ONVIF, WebRTC streaming.



What we need



Strong Python in production — you understand async, blocking calls, connection pools

Solid JavaScript or TypeScript, and you've shipped frontends

Real Linux experience — SSH into a sick server and work out what's wrong

Networking: NAT, VPNs, routing, firewalls. A lot of our debugging lives here

Willingness to work things out when there's no documentation. This matters more than any specific skill on this list



Nice to have (not required — we'll teach you if you are really smart)



RTSP, ONVIF, WebRTC, ffmpeg. CCTV hardware — Hikvision, Dahua, Uniview. 4G/LTE routers. LLM tool-use APIs.



What we're not



No big team, no product manager, no ticket queue. Some weeks are new features, some are firefighting. We want someone smart and curious, not someone who needs a spec handed to them.

title: Pre-Construction & Permitting Coordinator
description:
Pre-Construction & Permitting Coordinator



Full-Time | Remote | Philippines | U.S. Eastern Time Hours



About Character Companies



Character Companies is a fast-growing residential homebuilding and real estate development company based in Northern Virginia, USA.



We build new homes throughout the Washington, D.C. metropolitan area and are looking for an exceptional Pre-Construction & Permitting Coordinator to join our team remotely.



You will work directly with our Pre-Construction Manager and help manage permitting, utilities, consultants, and pre-construction activities across a growing portfolio of residential construction projects.



This is not a general Virtual Assistant position.



This is a project coordination role for someone who is organized, persistent, proactive, comfortable on the phone, and operates with a strong sense of urgency.



Your primary objective will be to help us reduce the amount of time it takes to get our homes permitted and ready for construction.



Our Core Values



Our culture is extremely important to us. Everyone at Character Companies is expected to live our three core values:



FAIL FORWARD

We move quickly, take ownership, learn from mistakes, and continuously improve.



FIGURE IT OUT

We are resourceful. When we encounter a problem, we don't simply report it - we work to find the solution.



FUEL THE VIBE

We bring positive energy, communicate well, support our teammates, and make the people around us better.



These aren't just words on a wall. They influence how we hire, work, evaluate performance, and grow our team.



Your Mission



Drive down our pre-construction and permitting cycle time.



We don't want someone who simply tracks how long things are taking.



We want someone who helps make them take less time.



That requires urgency, organization, persistence, excellent follow-up, and strong communication.



If a permit isn't moving, find out why.



If a reviewer hasn't responded, follow up.



If an engineer owes us a revision, call them.



If a utility application is sitting in a queue, determine what is needed to move it forward.



If you can't solve something yourself, identify the problem clearly and escalate it to our Pre-Construction Manager.



Nothing should sit because nobody followed up.



What You'll Own



Permitting & Government Coordination



Track building, demolition, grading, trade, right-of-way, and other permits across multiple residential projects.



Monitor government permitting portals daily.



Prepare and submit permit applications and supporting documentation.



Track review deadlines, comments, corrections, resubmissions, and approvals.



Call and
 government reviewers to obtain updates and resolve outstanding items.



Coordinate responses between architects, engineers, surveyors, consultants, and our internal team.



Schedule inspections and track corrections through completion.



Maintain accurate documentation of submissions, conversations, approvals, and outstanding requirements.



Utility Coordination



Initiate and track electric, gas, water, sewer, and telecommunications applications.



Communicate directly with U.S. utility companies.



Follow up regarding utility designs, work orders, inspections, meter installations, and service activation.



Track required payments, documents, easements, load information, and approvals.



Identify stalled utility requests and proactively work to get them moving.



Pre-Construction Coordination



Maintain our master pre-construction schedule and tracker across all active projects.



Track architects, engineers, surveys, civil plans, permits, utilities, and other pre-construction deliverables.



Follow up with outside consultants on upcoming and overdue deliverables.



Maintain organized project records and correspondence.



Maintain a database of government reviewers, inspectors, utility representatives, engineers, and consultants.



Identify potential delays before they affect the project schedule.



Provide our Pre-Construction Manager with clear updates on projects requiring his attention.



Phone Communication Is a Major Part of This Position



You must be comfortable picking up the phone.



You will regularly call:



Government permitting departments



Permit reviewers



Utility companies



Architects



Engineers



Surveyors



Consultants



Vendors



Excellent spoken English is therefore extremely important.



We're looking for someone who can confidently and professionally have a conversation, ask good questions, obtain clear answers, and respectfully push for the next action.



If you strongly prefer communicating only through
 or messaging, this position will not be a good fit.



Who We're Looking For



You should be:



Extremely organized and detail-oriented



Highly responsive with a strong sense of urgency



Persistent without being unprofessional



Proactive and resourceful



An excellent English speaker



A strong written communicator



Confident making outbound phone calls



Comfortable managing many projects and deadlines simultaneously



Comfortable learning unfamiliar processes



Comfortable asking questions when something doesn't make sense



Able to identify problems and propose solutions



Comfortable holding outside consultants accountable to deadlines



Able to determine when an issue needs to be escalated



We especially value people who naturally think:



"What can I do to move this forward today?"



Preferred Experience



Experience in any of the following is highly valuable:



U.S. residential construction



Homebuilding



Construction project coordination



Permitting



Architecture or engineering



Utility coordination



Real estate development



Construction administration



Working remotely for a U.S.-based construction company



Previous U.S. permitting experience is preferred but not required for an exceptional candidate who learns quickly and demonstrates strong ownership.



Technology



You should be highly comfortable using technology and learning new software.



Our team uses platforms including:



JobTread



CompanyCam



Google Workspace



Microsoft Office



Government permitting portals



Utility provider portals



Cloud-based project management systems



How We Will Measure Success



This is an outcomes-driven position.



We will measure things including:



Permit cycle time



Days from submission to approval



Speed of responses to review comments



Outstanding permit items



Utility application and activation timelines



Consultant turnaround times



Accuracy of project tracking



Number of issues proactively identified and resolved



Ultimately, your performance comes down to one question:



Are our projects moving through pre-construction faster and more predictably because you're here?



Schedule



This is a full-time remote position based in the Philippines.



You must be willing to work primarily during U.S. Eastern Time business hours because you will communicate directly with U.S. government agencies, utility companies, consultants, and our internal team.



Compensation



Competitive compensation based on experience and qualifications.



We are looking for a long-term team member with the opportunity to take on greater responsibility as Character Companies continues to grow.



How to Apply



Please submit your resume and a short cover letter answering the questions below.



Generic or AI-generated cover letters that do not specifically answer these questions will not be considered.



1. Driving Down Permit Cycle Time



Your primary responsibility is to help Character Companies reduce the amount of time it takes to move a new home through permitting and into construction.



If you were given responsibility for 20 residential projects in various stages of permitting, what specific actions and systems would you implement to drive our average permitting cycle time down?



Be specific. We want to understand how you think.



2. Sense of Urgency



Tell us about a previous situation where something was delayed or wasn't moving quickly enough.



What did you personally do to move it forward?



3. Phone Communication



This position requires frequent outbound calls to U.S. government agencies, utility companies, engineers, architects, and consultants.



Describe your experience making professional outbound phone calls in English. Are you comfortable calling someone repeatedly when necessary to obtain an answer or move something forward?



4. Organization



Imagine you're responsible for tracking 20 projects, 40+ permit applications, multiple utility applications, and several outside consultants.



How would you organize your work so that nothing gets missed?



5. Figure It Out



You call a government permitting department about an application that hasn't moved in two weeks. The person tells you:



"It's still under review. Someone will contact you when it's ready."



What would you do next?



6. Relevant Experience



Tell us about any experience you have with:



Construction



Permitting



Project coordination



Utilities



Architecture/engineering



Real estate development



U.S.-based companies



Please include your expected monthly salary in PHP and confirm that you are available to work full-time during U.S. Eastern Time business hours.

This role will work closely with the existing Compliance team to assist drivers and employees, manage operational concerns, maintain accurate documentation, and ensure consistent communication and follow-through.



The ideal candidate has previous administrative experience, strong communication skills, and the confidence to make outbound calls, respond to incoming calls and messages, and ask questions to obtain the information needed to address an issue. Responsibilities include assisting drivers with operational concerns, such as application-related problems or vehicle issues, coordinating the appropriate assistance, documenting communications, and following up until issues are resolved or escalated to the appropriate person.



Candidates with transportation industry experience and familiarity with Electronic Logging Device (ELD) and Transportation Management System (TMS) platforms are preferred but not required. The ideal candidate is technologically savvy, highly organized, responsive, and capable of working independently. Strong initiative, urgency, problem-solving skills, and accountability are essential, as the role requires more than simply identifying a problem or sending a message; the candidate must take action and follow through.



Key Responsibilities:

* Support the existing Compliance team with daily administrative and operational tasks.

* Make outbound calls to drivers and employees when follow-up, clarification, or additional information is needed.

* Receive and respond to calls, text messages, and other communications from drivers and employees regarding operational concerns.

* Assist drivers experiencing application-related issues, vehicle problems, or other operational difficulties by identifying and coordinating the appropriate assistance.

* Follow up with drivers, employees, and relevant contacts to ensure that reported concerns are addressed in a timely manner.

* Take initiative in identifying appropriate next steps to resolve issues rather than simply forwarding messages or reporting problems.

* Maintain accurate records of communications, reported concerns, actions taken, and follow-up activities.

* Review information and documentation for accuracy and identify missing or incomplete details that require further action.

* Contact the appropriate individuals to obtain missing information or clarify discrepancies.

* Monitor outstanding concerns and assigned tasks to ensure consistent follow-through.

* Coordinate with the relevant internal personnel or service providers when additional assistance is required.

* Escalate urgent, unresolved, or out-of-scope issues to the appropriate supervisor or designated contact.

* Use computer applications, digital communication tools, and relevant company systems to manage information and complete assigned tasks.

* Learn and follow the client's established compliance procedures, operational workflows, and documentation requirements.



Required Skills & Qualifications:

* Previous administrative experience is required.

* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

* Confidence in making outbound calls and communicating directly with drivers and employees.

* Strong follow-up skills and the ability to maintain consistent communication until an issue is addressed.

* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.

* Good computer literacy and the ability to navigate digital tools and applications.

* Ability to maintain accurate records, document communications, and organize information.

* Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to identify appropriate next steps when handling operational concerns.

* Ability to work independently, take initiative, and manage assigned responsibilities without constant supervision.

* Ability to prioritize requests, respond promptly, and recognize when an issue requires escalation.

* Willingness to ask questions and seek clarification when instructions or information are incomplete.

* Ability to work 6 hours per day, 6 days per week, including weekends, subject to the final confirmed schedule.



Preferred Qualifications:

* Previous experience in transportation, trucking, logistics, or driver operations.

* Familiarity with Electronic Logging Device (ELD) systems.

* Familiarity with Transportation Management System (TMS) platforms.

* Previous experience supporting compliance administration, driver coordination, or transportation-related operations.



Note: An NBI or police clearance will be required upon acceptance of the job offer.

title: HR Strategic Support Partner to Founder and CEO
description:
Help build the next chapter of a full service HR consulting firm



We are a growing full service HR consulting firm helping organizations make sound people decisions and build stronger managers. Our work spans client HR support, an HR membership model, and a national initiative to make practical management development more accessible. We are also building opportunities to license our training content and expand its reach.



You will work directly with our founder and CEO, an experienced HR thought leader, as a strategic support partner in this next stage of growth. You will turn client conversations into action, keep complex work moving, and help build the reliable processes that let a small firm serve more clients well. Your judgment and follow-through will be visible in our client experience and in how the firm grows.



The impact you will make



• Move US HR client projects forward across the employee life cycle. Organize facts, research questions, prepare drafts of HR documents, and flag matters requiring the CEO’s review or decision.

• Draft useful recaps and action items after membership and client calls. Capture guidance, decisions, next steps, owners, and deadlines, then follow commitments through to completion.

• Support membership onboarding, HR portal and learning system access, course assignments, reports, recordings, and member follow-up.

• Keep assigned Trello boards, client records, SharePoint files, and SOPs accurate and easy to use. Identify gaps, stalled work, and opportunities to improve processes.

• Identify potential sponsors and partners for our national initiative. Research fit, draft tailored outreach, and keep conversations and commitments moving.

• Source prospective clients for our HR membership model. Make thoughtful outreach calls and send
s to introduce the offering, learn about their needs, and identify promising opportunities.

• Conduct initial conversations with interested prospects, document their goals and questions, and coordinate a clear handoff to the founder and CEO for the next discussion.



What will help you succeed



• Minimum of 3 years of hands-on experience supporting a Founder, CEO or C-Level executive.

• Minimum 5 years US HR operations or consulting clients, with working knowledge of the employee life cycle. 

• Strong written and spoken English and sound judgment. 

• An owner’s mindset: you organize your own work, close loops, keep records current, and communicate progress and risks early.

Tools

, WordPress, and SOP documentation is valuable. We will orient you to our specific systems and processes.

title: Bookkeeper - Virtual
description:
Role Title: Bookkeeper

Company: By The 10th, an emerging AI-powered accounting and bookkeeping firm

Reports To: Founders

Location: Remote - Philippines-based candidates

Work Schedule: Part-time to start, expected to grow to full-time as the client base grows. Must be available during US overlap hours (9am–5pm MST).

Compensation: $4.00 USD/hour to start, with growth opportunities as the firm grows



About Us

By The 10th is an early-stage accounting and bookkeeping firm that combines AI automation with expert human oversight to deliver fast, accurate, and affordable financials to small businesses, every month, by the 10th. Many of our clients are in the real estate industry, including rental property owners. We are building our team now, and this is a true ground-floor opportunity to grow with us from day one.



Role Purpose

The Bookkeeper is the expert eye behind our AI. Using our proprietary AI software and workflow, you will review and correct AI-coded transactions, produce accurate financial statements and reports, and make sure every client receives their financials by the 10th of each month. This role is about ownership: catching what the AI misses, keeping your clients' books clean, and helping us improve the process as we scale.



Key Responsibilities



1. Accurate Books:

- Keep every assigned client's books clean and correct.

- AI review & correction: Review AI-coded transactions in our proprietary software and correct any miscategorized or unclear items.

- Categorization & property allocation: Categorize transactions accurately and consistently across all assigned clients, and allocate each transaction to the correct property for real estate and rental clients.

- Quality: Spot patterns in AI errors and flag them so the workflow can be improved.

- Confidentiality: Protect client information and handle sensitive financial data with care.



2. Financial Reporting by the 10th:

- Deliver on the promise in our name.

- Statements & reports: Generate monthly financial statements and reports using our proprietary AI software.

- On-time delivery: Deliver financials to every assigned client by the 10th of each month.

- Deadline tracking: Track month-end deadlines and raise any risk to the founders early, with a proposed solution.



3. Client Support:

- Be a clear, reliable point of contact for your clients.

- Information requests: Request documents and clarification on unclear transactions, and follow up until resolved.

- Client questions: Respond professionally to client questions about their books and reports, escalating to the founders when needed.

- Process improvement: Share ideas to make the workflow faster, more accurate, and easier for clients.



Requirements

- Minimum 3 years of bookkeeping or accounting experience

- Experience with real estate or rental property bookkeeping is a strong plus

- Strong written English communication skills

- Highly detail-oriented, organized, and able to meet firm monthly deadlines

- Comfortable learning new software, including proprietary AI tools (we will train you on our system)

- Self-directed and comfortable in an early-stage, evolving environment

- Reliable internet connection and a quiet remote work setup

- Experience with AI tools is helpful but not required



Success in This Role Looks Like...

Accurate Books - AI-coded work is reviewed and corrected thoroughly, and supervisor reviews turn up very few errors.

Financial Reporting by the 10th - Every client receives accurate financials by the 10th, every month.

Client Support - Clients get clear, timely answers and feel confident in their numbers.

KPI Achievement - Books closed and financials delivered by the 10th: 100%, Low error rate on supervisor review, Maintain the client load set by the founders



Compensation & Growth

Starting rate: $4.00 USD/hour, part-time to start.

Hours: Expected to grow to full-time as the firm acquires more clients.

Growth: As a new and growing company, we offer a ground-floor opportunity, with raises and expanded responsibility as the firm grows.



How to Apply

Reply to this job post with “By the 10th” in the subject line.

In your response, state:

- how many years of bookkeeping experience you have

- any relevant experience with AI you have (not required but helpful)

Tell us one thing that sets you apart from other applicants.



***Applications that do NOT follow these instructions will be automatically disqualified without opening.

title: Senior Video Editor & Creative Strategist — Ecommerce, Meta Ads & VSLs
description:
We’re looking for an experienced Video Editor and Creative Strategist to take ownership of performance creatives for our ecommerce brands.



We currently generate five-figure daily revenue and are scaling toward six figures per day. We need someone who can deliver at that pace, think independently, and connect creative decisions to business results.



You must have hands-on experience creating video ads for Scandinavian ecommerce brands and other European markets. Please include relevant examples in your application.



THE ROLE



You will own the creative process from research and concept development through scripting, editing, performance analysis, and iteration.



We will provide winning ads, customer insights, and performance data so you understand what has worked. Your job is to turn those insights into fresh concepts, stronger angles, and original executions.



Simply copying existing ads, changing captions, or swapping clips is not enough. You should understand why an ad works and use that understanding to create something new.



We expect you to identify what is needed, make informed decisions, and deliver without requiring detailed instructions for every script, scene, or edit.



WHAT YOU WILL DO



• Develop original ad concepts, hooks, angles, and scripts based on customer motivations, objections, product positioning, and performance insights.



• Create short-form direct-response ads, UGC-style creatives, product demonstrations, and longer video sales letters.



• Plan and produce B-roll, including original AI-generated footage where appropriate, and source suitable licensed assets when needed.



• Build complete ads with strong pacing, clear storytelling, effective voiceovers, readable captions, sound design, and relevant visuals.



• Adapt creatives for Scandinavian and other European audiences, paying attention to language, cultural context, credibility, and buying behavior.



• Analyze creative performance using metrics such as hook rate, retention, CTR, conversion rate, CPA, and ROAS. Understand these metrics in the context of spend, audience, offer, and landing-page performance.



• Identify why an ad is succeeding or underperforming, then propose specific changes and new tests.



• Maintain an organized creative testing process with clear hypotheses, consistent file naming, and documented learnings.



WHAT WE REQUIRE



• Proven experience editing direct-response video ads for Scandinavian brands and other EU ecommerce markets.



• A portfolio demonstrating both strong editing and strategic thinking.



• Experience writing original scripts and building VSLs with a clear hook, problem, product explanation, proof, objection handling, and call to action.



• The ability to turn customer research and performance data into creative decisions.



• Strong judgment when selecting or creating B-roll. Visuals should support the message and product accurately.



• Reliable communication, fast execution, attention to detail, and the ability to manage several creative tests at once.



• Ownership of the work: proactively suggest ideas, flag missing information, solve problems, and follow through.



• Your own editing software, creative tools, and any subscriptions needed to produce the work.



Success in this role means consistently producing fresh, well-reasoned creatives, learning from their performance, and improving the next round of ads.



IMPORTANT — UNPAID TRIAL AD



If your portfolio is shortlisted, you will be asked to create one unpaid trial ad so we can assess your actual editing, scripting, and creative strategy skills.



You must use your own software, tools, and subscriptions to complete the test.



Please apply only if you accept these conditions and can independently deliver work that matches the quality of your portfolio. This helps both sides avoid wasting time.



IMPORTANT — WRITE YOUR OWN APPLICATION



AI-generated applications will be ignored and will not receive a response.



Write your application in your own words. We want specific examples of your experience, your contribution to the work, and how you think about creative performance. Generic cover letters and copy-paste answers will not be considered.



HOW TO APPLY



Please include:



Three to five relevant ads you personally worked on, including at least one VSL or longer direct-response video.



The Scandinavian and European brands or markets you have worked with. If client names are confidential, describe the market, product category, and your responsibilities.



Your exact contribution to each example: strategy, research, scripting, B-roll, editing, or the complete process.



One example of how you used performance data to improve a creative. Explain the problem, what you changed, and the result. Redacted screenshots are welcome where you have permission to share them.



The tools you use for editing, research, B-roll production, and AI-assisted creative work.



Your weekly availability, earliest start date, and expected hourly or monthly rate.



Confirmation that you understand and accept the unpaid trial requirement and will use your own tools.



We are hiring as soon as possible and are looking for a reliable, long-term collaborator. Applications with relevant work examples and clear evidence of independent thinking will receive priority.

title: Senior Creative Strategist & Video Editor – DTC E-commerce / Meta Ads
description:
Senior Creative Strategist & Video Editor – DTC / Meta Ads



We are looking for a Creative Strategist & Video Editor to become a key part of our DTC e-commerce operation.



We are currently doing 5 figures in daily revenue and our goal is to scale toward $100,000+ per day.



Creative is one of the most important parts of our growth, and we are looking for someone who can eventually take significant ownership of the creative side of the brand.



This is NOT just a video editing position.



We need someone who understands Meta Ads, direct-response marketing, creative strategy, customer psychology and performance creative — while also being able to execute and edit high-quality video ads.



WHAT YOU WILL DO



Your job will be to help us produce, analyze and continuously improve performance creatives for Meta.



You will:



Develop and execute new Meta ad creatives

Study our winning ads and understand why they are working

Build new iterations and executions from proven winning concepts

Develop new hooks, openings, scripts and variations

Edit high-performing direct-response video ads

Create UGC-style ads, VSLs, advertorial-style ads and other performance formats

Research competitors and the market to identify new opportunities

Understand our customer, their problems, desires and buying motivations

Analyze creative performance and use the data to d
 what should be created next

Identify creative fatigue and produce new iterations before winners stop performing

Work with Meta Ads performance data rather than creating based purely on personal preference

Continuously test new ideas while scaling what already works



As you prove yourself, the goal is for you to take more and more ownership of the brand's creative strategy and production.



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR



You should have a strong understanding of:



Meta Ads

DTC e-commerce

Direct-response marketing

Creative strategy

Video editing

Hooks and angles

Customer psychology

UGC advertising

VSLs

Creative testing

Creative iteration

Competitor and market research

Performance metrics

Scaling creatives as ad spend increases



You should understand that a good-looking video is not necessarily a good ad.



We care about performance.



You should be able to look at an existing winning ad, understand the underlying message, angle, psychology and structure, and use those learnings to create new ads that can potentially outperform it.



IMPORTANT – 2 TEST VIDEO ADS REQUIRED



Please read this before applying.



The first step of our hiring process is creating 2 test video ads for our brand.



We are NOT asking you to figure everything out from zero.



We will give you our winning ads and show you the concepts, messaging and angles that are currently working for us.



From there, we want you to study the winners, understand why they work, and show us what you can create from that information.



Your task will be to create 2 complete video ads that you believe could perform on Meta.



You can use our winning ads as inspiration and direction, but we do not want simple copies.



We want to see whether you can take something that is already proven and create new hooks, iterations, executions and ideas around the winning message.



We will evaluate:



Your understanding of our winning ads

Your creative strategy

Your hooks

Your ability to build on proven concepts

Your direct-response thinking

Your video editing

Your pacing and storytelling

Your understanding of Meta advertising

Your ability to create something that could realistically become another winning ad

PLEASE DO NOT APPLY IF YOU WON'T DO THE TEST



We want to be very clear about this.



If you are not willing to create the 2 test video ads, please do not apply.



If you only send us a CV, generic cover letter or portfolio and are unwilling to complete the test, we will not move forward with your application.



We are looking for serious candidates who are willing to show us what they can actually do.



WHAT HAPPENS AFTER THE TEST?



If we like your 2 test ads, we will invite you to an interview.



During the interview, we will discuss:



Your decisions behind the test creatives

Why you chose your hooks and structure

Your previous DTC experience

Your Meta Ads knowledge

How you analyze winners and losers

How you would approach creative testing at higher spend

How you could help us build and improve our creative operation



The strongest candidate will have the opportunity to join us full-time and long-term.



THE OPPORTUNITY



We are not looking for someone to edit a few videos and disappear.

title: Davinci Resolve Colorist
description:
About Us



Ryo Jaeger Productions (RJP) is a Hawaiʻi-based video production company specializing in commercial, branded, corporate, real estate, hospitality, and social media content.



We work with a diverse range of clients, from small businesses to established brands, producing everything from cinematic brand films and interviews to commercial campaigns and short-form social media reels. We're currently a small team of two: myself, Ryo, the owner and lead videographer based in Honolulu, and our video editor based in Manila.



As our client base and production volume continue to grow, we're looking to bring on a dedicated DaVinci Resolve Colorist to help elevate the overall visual quality of our productions.



The Role



We're looking for someone with a strong eye for color, consistency, and image quality. Our current bottleneck is color grading. While our editing workflow is established, we want to improve the finishing quality of our videos, particularly when it comes to:



Creating crisp, clean, professional-looking images without excessive softness, haze, or washed-out colors.

Maintaining consistent color temperatures and skin tones across interviews, real estate videos, and commercial projects.

Properly balancing exposure, contrast, saturation, and white balance.

Developing cinematic looks that complement each project's creative direction.

Maintaining visual consistency across multiple cameras, lighting conditions, and shooting environments.

Ensuring our social media reels look polished and retain their visual quality across platforms.



You'll work closely with our Manila-based editor, receiving locked timelines and source footage for grading before returning the finished material for final delivery. Our projects are shot on the A7siii, using SLOG3. 



The color grader will be hired at a minimum of 10 hours/month, with the option of increasing scope for any month.



Requirements



Strong proficiency in DaVinci Resolve, particularly its color grading tools.

A portfolio demonstrating professional color correction and creative grading.

Experience working with Sony S-Log3 footage.

Understanding of color management, color spaces, skin tones, and delivery formats.

Familiarity with Premiere Pro to DaVinci Resolve workflows, including XML round-tripping.

Ability to independently troubleshoot footage and identify technical issues.

Someone who reads instructions. In your reply to me, tell me about which animal you most identify with.

Reliable internet connection and sufficient local storage to download, manage, and archive large video projects.

Strong written and spoken English communication skills.

Ability to meet deadlines and work independently in a remote environment.

Experience grading commercial, real estate, interview, and social media content is highly preferred.



Who We're Looking For



Technical ability is important, but we're equally interested in finding the right person to join our small team. We're looking for someone who:



Takes ownership: Goes above and beyond the assigned task, identifies issues proactively, and takes pride in delivering excellent work.

Communicates well: Keeps the team informed, asks questions when necessary, and is comfortable collaborating remotely.

Has attention to detail: Notices inconsistencies that others might overlook and doesn't settle for a grade that's simply good enough.

Works well in small teams: Understands that we're a growing production company, not a large agency with multiple departments.

Is adaptable: Comfortable working across different industries, creative styles, and project requirements.

Wants to grow with us: We're looking to establish a long-term working relationship with someone who can become an important part of RJP as we continue to expand.

We value initiative. If you see an opportunity to improve our workflow, image quality, or overall production standards, we want to hear your ideas.

title: Executive Virtual Assistant | GoHighLevel & Business Operations
description:
Company: Lead Us Enterprise LLC

Position: Part-Time, Long-Term Virtual Assistant

Work Arrangement: Remote

Hours: Approximately 20 hours per week to start



PLEASE READ BEFORE APPLYING

This is a long-term Virtual Assistant position. This is NOT a project-based GoHighLevel job.



I am looking for someone who wants to become an ongoing part of my company and help manage the day-to-day backend operations of the business.



GoHighLevel experience is required because you will be responsible for helping build, maintain, troubleshoot, and improve our CRM, workflows, pipelines, and automations. However, GoHighLevel is only one part of this position.



Once the initial systems are built, your job does not end.



You will continue working with the company as a Virtual Assistant, helping manage leads, follow-ups, appointments, onboarding, organization, reporting, administrative tasks, and other ongoing backend responsibilities.



If you are only interested in completing a GoHighLevel setup/build and then moving on to another project, please do not apply.



About the Position

Lead Us Enterprise LLC is a growing tax preparation and business services company.



As the owner, I am looking to remove myself from many of the repetitive backend responsibilities of the business so I can spend more time generating revenue, recruiting, training, creating content, building relationships, and growing the company.



I need someone who can eventually become my right hand on the administrative and operations side of the business.



I am not looking for someone who needs to wait for instructions every day. I will provide direction and training on how my company operates, but I want someone who can learn the business, follow systems, recognize what needs attention, and take ownership of their responsibilities.



GoHighLevel Responsibilities

You will help:

- Manage and organize our GoHighLevel CRM

- Build and maintain pipelines

- Build workflows and automations

- Create forms and surveys

- Set up calendars and appointment systems

- Create automated
 and SMS follow-up

- Tag and segment contacts

- Organize leads by source and status

- Build and maintain recruiting workflows

- Build and maintain client follow-up systems

- Create appointment reminders and no-show follow-up

- Assist with funnels and landing pages when needed

- Test automations to make sure they are working correctly

- Troubleshoot GoHighLevel issues

- Clean and organize CRM data

- Recommend ways GoHighLevel can eliminate repetitive manual work

- Document systems and automations



Ongoing Virtual Assistant & Business Operations Responsibilities

This is an equally important part of the position.



Responsibilities may include:

- Monitor incoming leads

- Follow up with prospects using approved scripts

- Keep leads moving through the appropriate pipelines

- Manage appointment scheduling and rescheduling

- Follow up with no-shows

- Monitor company
 and identify items requiring my attention

- Assist with calendar management

- Track recruiting prospects

- Assist with new tax preparer onboarding

- Track onboarding requirements and outstanding tasks

- Maintain spreadsheets and business trackers

- Organize Google Drive and company files

- Perform data entry and CRM updates

- Create and maintain SOPs

- Conduct basic business research when needed

- Assist with routine client communication

- Coordinate with other team members and contractors

- Help keep projects, deadlines, and recurring tasks organized

- Prepare weekly reports showing leads, appointments, follow-ups, outstanding tasks, and items requiring my attention

- Handle other reasonable administrative and operational responsibilities as the company grows



What a Typical Week May Look Like

This position will not look exactly the same every day.



One day you may be building or troubleshooting a GoHighLevel workflow. Another day you may be following up with leads, updating pipelines, checking appointments, organizing files, updating a spreadsheet, documenting a process, assisting with onboarding, or completing other administrative work.



I am specifically looking for someone who enjoys both the technical GoHighLevel side AND the day-to-day Virtual Assistant and business operations side of the position.



What I Am Looking For

You should be:

- Experienced with GoHighLevel

- Experienced with workflows, pipelines, automations, forms, calendars,
 and SMS campaigns

- Comfortable performing general Virtual Assistant duties

- Organized and detail-oriented

- Reliable and consistent

- A strong written communicator

- Comfortable learning new systems

- Able to follow instructions and SOPs

- Able to work independently

- Proactive when you notice a problem or something that needs attention

- Comfortable suggesting better ways to complete repetitive tasks

- Able to manage multiple responsibilities

- Comfortable working with confidential business information

- Interested in a long-term working relationship



Experience supporting a tax, accounting, financial services, professional services, or lead-generation company is a plus, but not required.



This Position Is NOT For You If:

- You are only looking for GoHighLevel implementation projects

- You only want to build automations and leave once they are completed

- You are not interested in general Virtual Assistant or administrative responsibilities

- You need detailed instructions for every task before taking action

- You are currently overloaded with clients and cannot consistently dedicate time to this position

- You are looking for occasional freelance projects instead of an ongoing position



To Apply

Please begin your application with the words “LONG-TERM LEAD US VA” so I know you read the entire job posting.



Please briefly introduce yourself and tell me about your experience with GoHighLevel and ongoing Virtual Assistant/business operations work.



If available, you may also include examples of GoHighLevel workflows, automations, pipelines, funnels, or other systems you have personally built.



Important: This is an ongoing Virtual Assistant position, not a one-time GoHighLevel project. I am specifically looking for someone interested in becoming a long-term member of the Lead Us Enterprise team.

description:

Company: Medina Solutions  |  Openings: 2  |  Remote part time

Pay: [$30/week $130/month] plus [$50/ EVERY CLOSED DEAL]  |  Start: [October 5, 2026]

Medina Solutions helps US small businesses answer customer calls and book appointments with an AI receptionist. We also build websites for businesses that need one. We are hiring two appointment setters for the same role. You will call assigned owners, learn how they handle calls, mention a website when a real need appears, and book qualified meetings with our founder. You will not build websites, configure the receptionist, quote unapproved terms, or close contracts.

What you will do

• Call assigned, checked leads and reach the owner or appropriate decision maker.

• Ask how the business handles missed calls, after hours inquiries, spam calls, and appointment booking. Explain the approved AI receptionist offer accurately.

• Check the business website status. If it has no website or the owner describes a specific website problem, ask permission to discuss that need; offer a relevant website conversation without dropping a live receptionist opportunity.

• Book one meeting with the founder for the service or services the owner actually wants. Confirm name, business, phone,
, date and time, stated pain point, and service interest.

• Log each attempt, outcome, objection, next action, website status, and follow up in Zoho. Check duplicates and honor removal requests.

• Send approved confirmations, complete callbacks, flag high intent prospects, and submit the daily scorecard.

Three hour daily workflow

• First 10 minutes: review assigned leads, due follow ups, script, phone, CRM, and calendar.

• Next 130 minutes: focused calls and immediate CRM updates; ask about website need only when supported by the conversation or verified website status.

• Next 30 minutes: callbacks, meeting confirmations, and incomplete qualification notes.

• Final 10 minutes: hand off booked meetings and submit the scorecard.

Starting performance measures

Review attempts, decision makers reached, qualified meetings booked and attended, follow ups completed, accurate service tags, duplicate rate, and call quality. For an initial three hour shift, use 60 to 90 call attempts as a planning range when clean leads and a working dialer are supplied; calibrate after two weeks of actual results. Never count an unqualified calendar slot as a booking. Review two recordings per worker weekly where recording and disclosure are permitted.

Qualifications and equipment

• Clear spoken and written English; experience in outbound calling, appointment setting, sales, or customer service.

• Good discovery questions, natural delivery, accurate notes, and coachability. Familiarity with Zoho, a dialer, and Google Calendar is helpful.

• Reliable computer, stable internet, quality headset, quiet workspace, and backup internet or power plan when possible.

How to apply

• Subject line: MEDINA SETTER followed by your first name.

• Briefly describe your B2B calling and appointment setting experience.

• Attach a 60 to 90 second voice sample: introduce an AI receptionist and naturally bring up a website only after a plausible website need is revealed.

• Answer the six questions below in order. Include a recent internet speed screenshot, requested pay for 15 hours weekly, and confirmation of the posted shift.

Application questions

• What questions would you ask to learn whether an owner is missing calls or bookings?

• If the business has no website, how would you introduce that offer while preserving interest in the receptionist?

• What would you say if the owner replies, “My staff already answers the phone”?

• Which details must be confirmed before a meeting is booked, and how would you record interest in both services?

title: YouTube Video Editor for Personal Brand Channel
description:
I’m looking for a reliable, creative YouTube Video Editor to help me build and grow a personal-brand YouTube channel. I am looking for an editor to join as soon as Sunday Oct 4th, 2026.



My content focuses on helping women entrepreneurs with ADHD turn scattered tasks, ideas, and projects into simple systems so they know what to do next and actually finish what they start.



Topics may include:



- ADHD and entrepreneurship

- Productivity and organization

- Business systems and workflows

- AI and automation

- Delegation

- Overwhelm and task management

- Building a business when your brain has 47 tabs open



I will primarily be creating talking-head, educational, and story-based YouTube videos.



What You'll Be Doing



You will take my raw footage and turn it into polished, engaging YouTube videos.



This may include:



- Editing long-form YouTube videos

- Removing mistakes, pauses, filler, and unnecessary sections

- Tightening pacing to keep viewers engaged

- Adding B-roll where appropriate

- Adding text, graphics, screenshots, zooms, and visual emphasis

- Adding music and sound effects when appropriate

- Adding captions or emphasized keywords

- Creating pattern interrupts so the video doesn't feel like one long talking head

- Color correction and basic audio cleanup

- Following my branding and editing style

- Exporting finished videos in the correct YouTube format

- Organizing project files and completed videos



Depending on your skill set, there may also be opportunities to:



- Turn long-form videos into YouTube Shorts/Reels

- Help identify strong clips from each video

- Suggest edits that improve audience retention

- Help develop a consistent visual editing style for the channel



The Style I'm Looking For



I DON'T want videos that feel overly corporate, sterile, or like someone added an animation every three seconds just because they could.



I'm building a personality-driven educational channel. I like creatives that incorporate playfulness. 



The editing should feel:



Clean + conversational + energetic + smart + modern



Think editing that supports what I'm saying rather than distracting from it.



I want viewers to feel like they're sitting down with a smart friend who understands their brain and is helping them figure out what to do next.



Who I'm Looking For



You may be a great fit if you:



- Have experience editing YouTube content

- Understand pacing and viewer retention

- Know how to edit talking-head educational content

- Can tell the difference between an important pause and dead space

- Have strong attention to detail

- Can follow editing guidelines while also using good judgment

- Communicate clearly

- Meet deadlines consistently

- Are comfortable receiving feedback and making revisions

- Want a long-term working relationship rather than just completing one video



Experience editing content in the business, productivity, ADHD, education, coaching, or personal-brand space is a plus, but not required.



Important



I'm not looking for someone who simply asks "Where should I cut the video?"



I'm looking for an editor who can watch the content, understand the point I'm making, and make editing decisions that help tell the story and keep the viewer interested.



You don't have to be a YouTube strategist, but you should understand that YouTube editing is different from simply making a video look pretty.



Retention matters.



Compensation



Starting rate: $60 USD per completed 10–15 minute YouTube video. Hours can vary from 5 to 10 hours a week. 



This is a per-video role rather than an hourly position.



There is room to increase the rate based on the quality of your work, consistency, turnaround time, and our long-term working relationship.



Additional compensation may be available for Shorts/Reels or other editing projects outside the standard long-form video.



To Apply



Please send:



1. A short introduction about yourself.

2. At least 3 examples of YouTube videos you've edited, preferably talking-head or educational content.

3. What editing software you use.

4. Your typical turnaround time for a 10–15 minute YouTube video.

5. Your rate per video or hourly rate.

6. Whether you also edit Shorts/Reels.

7. A brief explanation of what you believe makes a talking-head YouTube video engaging.



And please start your application with the words "47 TABS"



This lets me know you actually read the job description.



Potential for Long-Term Work



I'm looking to build this channel consistently, so if we work well together, this can become an ongoing role with regular videos rather than a one-time project.

title: Live-Stream Moderator - Hourly Base + Commission | Growing Agency
description:

We are a creator management agency building a core team around our model's live-stream operations. We're a lean, fast-moving operation where the people who join now have a direct path to senior and leadership roles as we scale over the coming months.

We're not looking for someone to passively watch a chat scroll by. We're looking for someone who can control a room, protect the model's energy, and actively drive revenue - all at the same time.



The Role

As a Live-Stream Moderator, you are the backbone of the live stream. The model performs - you manage everything happening in the chat behind the scenes. You keep the energy high, remove bad actors instantly, engage viewers to stay longer, and push tips and purchases at the right moments without it feeling forced.

This is a fast-paced, real-time role. Slow reactions cost money. Good moderation makes the difference between a $200 stream and a $2,000 stream.

Day-to-day responsibilities:

Monitor and manage live chat in real time during scheduled streams

Remove, mute, and ban trolls, time-wasters, and rule-breakers immediately

Engage active viewers to maintain energy and encourage tipping

Pin strategic messages and tip goals at the right moments

Upsell PPV content, tip menus, and offers naturally during the stream

Relay relevant information or opportunities to the model without breaking her flow

Track stream performance and report key metrics after each session



Schedule

This is a fixed-schedule role. Streams run for 4 hours each on the following days and times (all times CET):

Thursday 5:00 AM

Friday 5:00 AM

Saturday 5:00 AM

Sunday 5:00 AM

Sunday 10:00 PM

That is 5 scheduled streams per week. You must be able to cover all of them consistently and reliably. If your schedule doesn't allow for this, please don't apply - we need someone we can count on every single week without chasing.



What We Offer

Hourly base rate - you get paid for every hour you're live, guaranteed, from day one

Commission on top - tied directly to stream revenue, so the better the stream performs, the more you earn on top of your base

Bi-Weekly payouts

Long-term: Senior moderator and leadership roles for top performers - we build our management team from within

This is a genuine ground-floor opportunity. The people joining now will be the ones with the most experience, the most trust, and the first pick of leadership positions as we grow.



You Are a Strong Fit If:

You can reliably show up for every scheduled stream - no exceptions, no last-minute cancellations

You can multitask in a high-speed environment without missing critical moments

You have a good instinct for when to push a sale and when to let a moment breathe

You stay calm and decisive when dealing with aggressive or toxic users

You can work independently without needing direction mid-stream

You understand your job directly impacts revenue - and you take that seriously

You want more than just a moderation gig - you want a role with real upward potential

ADDITIONAL: You have experience moderating live streams (Twitch, YouTube, Kick, or similar)



This Is Not For You If:

You can't commit to the fixed schedule above consistently

You're looking for something low-effort and passive

You can't make quick decisions under pressure

You get rattled by aggressive or inappropriate comments

You're unreliable with scheduled commitments



Compensation

Hourly base rate (paid for every stream hour worked)

Commission on stream revenue on top of the hourly base

Bi-Weekly payouts



How to Apply

We don't review generic applications. To be considered fill out the Typeform below:

title: Remote Cold Caller – AI Phone Receptionist for US Trade Businesses (US Pacific hours)
description:
We're a small US software company near Seattle, hiring 1 remote caller, starting with a paid two-week trial.



Hours: Full-time, 7-8 hours per day, Monday-Friday, US Pacific business hours (overnight in the Philippines).

Pay: Base plus commission on every paid setup. A good performer earns around $1,000/month all-in. Paid two-week trial to start.



WHAT WE DO

We make an AI phone receptionist for small trade businesses: plumbers, painters, electricians, HVAC. When the owner is on a job and can't answer, the AI answers as their company, takes the caller's name and number, and promises a callback. It's built from the customer's own website in minutes. Plans are $50-150/month.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Call locally owned trade businesses in the US (we start with plumbers in Portland, Oregon) from our calling system. You'll ramp from 40 to 60 to 80 dials a day over the first weeks. Most calls hit voi
. The ones that connect get your full attention.

- Run a short, honest opening (we don't hide that it's a cold call), ask one real question, and listen.

- Offer a live demo: you bring the AI receptionist into the call and the owner hears her answering as their own company. The demo does most of the selling.

- Close to a paid start: a $100 setup fee that includes the first month of service. Send the payment link, confirm it went through, log the call.

- Log every dial honestly in our system. We review call recordings every day.

- Work directly with the founder. Daily 15-minute coaching call in the first weeks, then a few times a week.



WHAT WE NEED

- Real outbound cold-calling or appointment-setting experience for US or English-speaking clients. Tell us your numbers: dials per day, connects, appointments or sales.

- Clear, warm, unhurried spoken English. Clarity matters more than accent.

- Someone who listens. This job is not reading a script at people.

- Coachable. We give one note, you change it on the next call.

- Honest. Every disposition you log gets checked against recordings. If that sounds fair to you, you're our kind of person.

- Reliable at US Pacific hours from a quiet room, with a headset and stable internet.

- Comfortable with a dialer, a simple CRM-style tool, and conferencing a third party into a call.



NOT A FIT

- If you advertise 200+ dials a day, this isn't the job. That's robo-dialing, not selling.

- If most of your experience is consumer telemarketing (insurance leads, timeshares), it's probably not a fit. We call business owners.

- If you need a script for every sentence.



HOW TO APPLY (REQUIRED)

1. A 60-second voice recording, sent as a Google Drive or Vocaroo link. Read this cold, then talk for 30 seconds about the last thing you sold and how:

"Hi, is this Mike? My name is [your name]. I'll be straight with you, this is a cold call. I'm calling plumbers because most plumbers lose money every week when calls hit voi
, and we built a fix for it. Can I ask you one question?"

2. Your last cold-calling role with numbers: dials per day, connect rate, what you sold, how long you stayed, why you left.

3. Confirm you can work US Pacific hours and describe your setup (room, headset, internet).



Applications without the voice recording won't be reviewed.



HOW IT WORKS

We start with a paid two-week trial on a real list with real tools. If you dial consistently, listen, log honestly, and take coaching, the real role starts, month to month.

title: Media Buyer, Meta + Google + LinkedIn Ads (part-time, remote, ongoing)
description:
Irish digital marketing agency looking for a reliable, experienced paid media buyer to run campaigns across Meta, Google and LinkedIn for a growing roster of small and medium business clients.

About us

We're a small Dublin-based agency serving Irish SMEs. We handle strategy, creative and client relationships in-house. We need you to own the platform execution so we can scale.

The role

You'll manage live ad accounts for six to twelve clients at a time, with monthly ad spend ranging from €500 to €3000 per account. Your job is to make the campaigns work and keep them working.

What you'll do

Set up Meta Business Manager, Google Ads and LinkedIn Campaign Manager accounts, including pixels, conversion tracking and audience setup. Build campaigns from a brief we provide (objective, audience, budget, creative). Upload creative we supply and write ad copy variants where needed. Monitor spend and performance daily. Pause underperformers, scale winners, run A/B tests. Pull weekly performance data into our reporting template. Flag issues, disapprovals or anomalies to us the same day they happen. Keep clean naming conventions and campaign structures across all accounts.

What you need

Three or more years running paid campaigns on Meta and Google at a minimum. LinkedIn Ads experience strongly preferred. Meta Blueprint or Google Ads certifications a plus. Confident with conversion tracking, UTM parameters, GA4 and pixel setup. Comfortable managing multiple accounts in parallel without missing details. Strong written English and reliable daily communication on Slack. Able to work roughly four to six hours overlap with Irish business hours (GMT/IST).

What we provide

Written briefs for every campaign. All creative assets, copy direction and audience research. A reporting template. Clear onboarding and SOPs. Direct access to us on Slack during working hours.

The setup

Part-time to start, roughly 20 to 25 hours per week, with view to full-time within three to six months as the client base grows. Fully remote, long-term position. Paid monthly.

Trial

One-month paid trial on two to three accounts to see how we work together. If it lands, we move to a longer-term arrangement.

When applying, please include

Links to two or three accounts or campaigns you've managed, with results (CPL, ROAS, scale). Your current availability and preferred working hours. Your monthly rate expectation for part-time. One sentence on which platform you're strongest on and why.

Looking forward to hearing from you.

title: DTC Video Editor & Scriptwriter (VSLs & AI Ads)
description:
We’re hiring a video editor who can write scripts and turn them into finished DTC ads.



You need to understand hooks, angles, customer pain points, objections and pacing. You should be able to study a winning ad, understand what makes it work, and build new scripts and variations around that concept.



VSL experience is strongly preferred. You also need to adapt to UGC, product ads and shorter Meta creatives depending on the brief.



We’re a Swedish brand selling across Scandinavia and the Netherlands. Experience creating DTC ads for these markets is a strong plus, especially if you know how to adapt scripts, messaging and visuals to local audiences.



You’ll be expected to:



- Write complete scripts with a clear hook, body and CTA.

- Edit the ad from start to finish, including voiceover, captions, sound and visuals.

- Find or generate B-roll that actually matches what the script is saying.

- Create new hooks and iterations from our best-performing ads.

- Take feedback, meet deadlines and communicate clearly.



You must already know how to use AI tools for video, images and voiceovers, and have access to the tools needed to complete the test. Once you join the team, we’ll cover the AI subscriptions required for the work.



Shortlisted applicants will receive a brief and examples of our best-performing ads. You’ll then create ONE unpaid test ad so we can assess your scripting, creative decisions and editing. The test is unpaid, so please apply only if you’re comfortable with this.



To apply, send:



1. Two or three relevant DTC ads you’ve worked on. Include a VSL if you have one.

2. A clear explanation of what you personally handled in each example: script, editing, AI footage or the full creative.

3. The AI tools you currently use and have access to.



Please apply only if you have relevant work to show and can handle both the script and the edit independently. We need someone who can take a brief, make decisions and deliver a finished ad.

title: Video Editor: Motion Graphics, Talking Head, Event Recaps (After Effects / Premiere Pro)

A strong sense of pacing, music syncing, and what performs on social media. Ability to take feedback, hit deadlines, and work independently. If this sounds like you and you enjoy working across a variety of industries, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Short-Form UGC Video Editor – Long-Term Opportunity
description:
I’m a U.S.-based UGC creator looking for a reliable short-form video editor to work with long-term.



I create direct-response UGC ads for apparel, fitness, lifestyle, and other consumer brands. Most videos are approximately 15–45 seconds and are used for Instagram,
, TikTok, and paid advertising.



I’m currently producing a fairly high volume of content and want to find one editor who can learn my style and eventually handle most of my editing without needing detailed instructions for every video.



PAY:

Starting around $5-$7 USD per finished video.



Some projects will be very simple, while others may require more editing. I’m open to discussing different rates for more complicated projects or multiple variations of the same video.



I also plan to offer performance bonuses for exceptional videos as we build a long-term working relationship.



WHAT I’M LOOKING FOR:



• Experience editing short-form / UGC content

• Strong sense of pacing and attention retention

• Clean cuts and natural-looking edits

• Good use of on-screen text and captions

• Ability to use B-roll, overlays, music, and product footage when appropriate

• Ability to keep videos simple and native-looking when that is the better choice

• Good creative judgment

• Reliable turnaround

• Good communication in English

• Comfortable receiving and delivering files through Google Drive

• Willingness to learn my editing style over time



I do NOT want every video heavily edited with unnecessary effects, transitions, zooms, or captions. A lot of my best-performing ads are simple. The goal is to make the video better, not make the editing distracting.



--------------------------------------------------

APPLICATION TEST – PLEASE READ CAREFULLY

--------------------------------------------------



I am using a short editing assignment as the first part of the application process.



TEST FILES:





Inside the folder you will find:



• The raw footage

• The finished video that I edited myself



YOUR TASK:



Recreate my finished video using the raw footage provided.



I want the timing, pacing, cuts, text placement, music/style, and overall feel to be as close to my finished version as reasonably possible.



However, please CHANGE the visual style of the on-screen text slightly (font, styling, or another obvious text detail) so I can verify that you actually recreated the video yourself.



You do not have to use the exact same background music. Choose something similar that you think works well. 



Do not simply send my finished reference video back to me.



In the Google Drive folder you will also find several additional finished videos labeled “OTHER EXAMPLES OF MY STYLE.”



You do NOT need to recreate those videos.



They are only included so you can get a better understanding of the different types of UGC ads I create and my overall editing style.



For this first assignment, ONLY recreate the video located in the “VIDEO TO RECREATE” folder.



When you apply, please send me:



1. A link to your completed recreation

2. 2–3 examples of your best short-form or UGC edits

3. What editing software you use

4. Your normal rate for a 15–45 second short-form video

5. Approximately how many videos you could edit per week

6. Your typical turnaround time

7. A short answer explaining why you think you would be a good fit for this position



IMPORTANT:



Start your application with the words:



HEATH VIDEO EDITOR



If those words are not at the beginning of your application, I will assume the full job post was not read.



--------------------------------------------------

SECOND ROUND

--------------------------------------------------



I will select a small number of the strongest applicants for a second test.



For that test, I will provide raw footage and other materials for another ad, but I will NOT show you my finished version.



You will edit it based on what you learned about my style from the first assignment.



This second test is designed to find someone who can eventually understand my style and make good editing decisions without me directing every individual cut.



I’m looking for someone I can build a long-term working relationship with. There should be consistent ongoing work for the right person.

title: Digital Marketing & Content Coordinator

One business account you managed and the results you achieved.

Your answers to these questions:
