title: Trailer Management Admin
description:
GH Logistics (AJG Transport) is a high performance freight brokerage and asset based logistics company specializing in dry van and refrigerated freight. We move quickly, but we move with structure. Our operation is built on real-time visibility, disciplined execution, and clear communication. We take pride in keeping freight organized, assets accounted for, and operations running cleanly from pickup to delivery.



If you’re someone who enjoys structured execution, asset visibility, and maintaining operational accuracy behind the scenes, you’ll feel right at home here.



Role Overview

You support the Trailer Manager in overseeing a fleet of 1000+ trailers across multiple carriers and terminals. You play a critical role in ensuring every trailer is accounted for, properly assigned, compliant, and operational. This is not a passive data-entry role. You’re the person who keeps the fleet picture accurate, coordinates trailer repair concerns, and flags problems before they cost us time and money.



You should be familiar with common trailer repair and maintenance issues and understand how to coordinate practical solutions with drivers, terminals, vendors, and maintenance teams. If you thrive on structure, take pride in clean records, and don’t let things slip through the cracks, this role was built for you.



What You’ll Be Doing

• Monitor, update, and reconcile trailer locations across the network on a daily basis

• Coordinate with route supervisors, internal team, dispatchers, carriers, drivers, and terminals to ensure accurate trailer assignments and timely movement

• Track trailer availability, maintenance schedules, and repair status

• Identify trailer issues, assess their operational impact, and coordinate the appropriate repair solution

• Maintain accurate and up-to-date trailer documentation (registrations, inspections, tags, insurance)

• Support reporting on trailer utilization, downtime, and compliance

• Identify discrepancies, missing updates, or unreported trailer statuses and escalate promptly

• Assist in improving internal trailer tracking systems for better visibility and accuracy

• Execute processes consistently with strong attention to detail

• Collaborate cross-functionally with dispatch, compliance, and maintenance teams



What Success Looks Like

• Trailer locations and statuses are consistently accurate and fully reconciled

• Assignments, availability, and movements are properly documented and updated in real time

• Maintenance, repair, and compliance records are complete and up to date

• Trailer defects and repair needs are identified early, properly communicated, and resolved efficiently

• Discrepancies are identified early and resolved before impacting operations

• Reporting on utilization and downtime is clean, accurate, and actionable

• Communication across departments is clear, timely, and structured



Who We’re Looking For

• Experience in fleet management, trailer maintenance coordination, logistics coordination, truck or trailer repairs, dispatch, or similar live operational roles (not general admin work)

• Familiarity with common dry van and refrigerated trailer repairs, defects, and maintenance concerns

• Ability to understand trailer repair issues, determine the appropriate next steps, and coordinate solutions

• Knowledge of common trailer components and issues, such as tires, brakes, lights, doors, landing gear, air lines, electrical systems, refrigeration units, and structural damage, is strongly preferred

• Strong attention to detail with high accuracy in tracking and record-keeping

• Organized and capable of managing multiple data points across systems and teams

• Clear and professional communication skills across departments

• Familiarity with platforms such as Samsara, LoadStop, or similar tracking systems is a plus

• Proactive mindset, able to identify and address issues before they escalate

• Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills in a fast-paced environment

• Minimum 45 WPM typing speed

• Proficient in Microsoft Office, Google Workspace, and Logistics tools

• Reliable internet connection and fully equipped remote work setup

• Team oriented, coachable, and aligned with structured processes



Schedule & Work Setup

• Full time permanent remote role

• Direct Hire to a US Company (not agency or BPO)

• Current needed shifts: Tuesday - Saturday 8 PM - 6 AM CDT

• Reliable home office setup and back up internet and power stations

• Zoom presence required (camera on throughout shift)

• Hubstaff time tracking during shifts.



What You'll Get

• Independent Contractor Setup

• $75 monthly insurance stipend (eligibility begins 30 days after hire)

• Paid biweekly. No delayed payments and no excuses.

• Stable & long-term position. This is not project-based nor seasonal. We're building a team and we need people who want to build with us.

• Direct access to US executive leadership. You're not buried in a call center reporting to a middle manager. You work directly with our operations team.

• Real operations work.



Who Thrives Here

• People who've worked in a US freight brokerage or 3PL and want something more stable

• Former fleet coordinators, logistics admins, or dispatch support staff who are tired of BPO environments

• Fleet admins who take ownership. You don't clock in and zone out. You manage trailers like they are your business.

• People who can recognize trailer issues, coordinate repairs, follow up consistently, and ensure equipment returns to service as quickly as possible

• People who want to grow into leadership but need the right company to do it in.



Who This Isn't For

• General VAs looking for easy remote work. This is real logistics and not admin tasks.

• People who need constant supervision or step by step instructions for every task

• Anyone who can't commit to US shift hours consistently

• Candidates without actual freight/logistics experience. We don't have time to teach the basics.

• Candidates who are unfamiliar with trailer maintenance concerns or are uncomfortable coordinating repairs and operational solutions



This role is built for someone who takes pride in maintaining control over moving assets, ensuring trailers are accounted for, properly assigned, properly repaired, and always operational. If you value structure, accuracy, problem-solving, and keeping operations running clean behind the scenes, you’ll thrive in this role.



Apply Here: 
/team/
/GHApplicationForm

title: Transportation Tracker - OTR Operations

Your responsibility is to ensure loads are properly assigned, tracked, updated, and documented while maintaining consistent communication across drivers, brokers, and customers. You will operate within structured SOPs while making fast, sound operational decisions when challenges arise.



What You’ll Be Doing

• Maintain accurate real-time load data, check calls, timestamps, delivery milestones, and documentation in TMS and Google Sheets.

• Communicate with drivers, brokers, and customers while proactively addressing delays, route conflicts, detention risks, and other service issues.

• Follow established dispatch and escalation SOPs, provide clear shift reports and handoffs, and escalate operational risks to leadership as needed.

description:
Growth Marketing Lead | Meta Ads + CRM + Funnel Optimization



We are looking for a senior, hands-on Growth Marketing Lead to help grow a local wellness business in Utah.

This is not primarily a social media, content, or basic media-buying role.

We are a location-based membership business with significant unused capacity, so profitable recurring membership growth is the primary objective.



Your responsibility is to help us improve the entire customer growth funnel:

Traffic → First Purchase → Visit → Second Visit → Membership → Retention → Referral



We already have:

- An operations lead

- An in-location manager

- A marketing/CRM execution team member

- Existing franchise marketing resources



You will own growth strategy and experimentation, including d
 what to test, prioritizing the work, directing our marketing execution resource, and measuring whether it is working.



Areas you may own

- Personally managing Meta campaigns, including campaign setup, audience strategy, budget allocation, optimization, creative testing, and performance analysis

- Customer segmentation and positioning

- Offers and landing pages

- Funnel/conversion optimization

- CAC, LTV and cohort analysis

- Tracking and attribution

-
/SMS lifecycle strategy

- First-visit and second-visit conversion

- Membership conversion

- Reactivation

- Retention and referrals

- Directing our existing marketing execution resource



This is a hands-on role. You will personally manage our paid media campaigns, especially during the initial 30–90 days, while directing other team members for CRM,
, SMS, reporting, and implementation support.  

We are looking for someone who can both execute where needed and operate at a higher level by diagnosing problems, prioritizing experiments, directing the team, and owning growth outcomes.



Initial engagement

We will begin with a paid 30-day trial. Your first objective will be to:

1. Understand our current funnel and customer economics.

2. Establish baseline metrics.

3. Identify the largest constraint to membership growth.

4. Prioritize and launch growth experiments.

5. Direct our existing team in execution.

6. Create a simple weekly growth scorecard.

7. Recommend the next 60–90 days.



If the fit is strong, this can become an ongoing and increasingly important role.

Expected capacity is approximately 20–25 hours per week.

Compensation is approximately $1,500–$2,500 USD/month depending on experience.



This is an outcome-oriented role rather than an hourly task-based position. We care more about ownership, judgment, experimentation, and measurable growth than hours logged.



To apply, please answer these questions

1. Give us 2–3 examples of growth initiatives you personally led.

For each include:

- The business/product

- The problem

- What you changed

- Actual results before and after

- What you personally owned

Include metrics such as CAC, conversion rate, revenue, ROAS, LTV, retention, or recurring revenue where possible.



2. Scenario

A local wellness business sells a first visit for $45.

Paid acquisition currently costs approximately $100–$130 per first-time purchaser. Most first-time customers do not return, membership conversion is low, and there is significant unused capacity.

You have an operations lead, an in-location manager, and a team member available to execute CRM/email/SMS work.

What would you investigate first, and what would your first 30 days look like?

Keep your response concise.



3. Include

- Current location/time zone

- Weekly availability

- Desired compensation

- Earliest start date



Please organize your application using the three sections above and keep it concise.

We value clear thinking and specific results over polished presentation.

title: Solar Project Manager – Remote
description:
Position: Solar Project Manager

Job Type: Temporary / Contract

Initial Duration: 3 Months

Potential for Full-Time: Yes, based on performance and company needs

Rate: $7–$9 USD per hour

Schedule: U.S. Business Hours

Location: Remote / Work From Home



We are a growing solar installation company looking for a reliable, organized, and proactive Solar Project Manager to help manage our solar projects from permit application through interconnection and PTO.



This is initially a 3-month temporary position, with the possibility of becoming a full-time, long-term position for the right person based on performance, reliability, and ability to manage projects independently.



We are looking for someone who can take ownership of projects, stay on top of deadlines, follow up with cities and utilities, and make sure projects keep moving forward.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

1. Permitting

Prepare and submit solar permit applications to the appropriate city/county/AHJ.

Track permit status and follow up with permitting departments.

Monitor plan check comments and correction notices.

Coordinate revisions and resubmissions.

Make sure permits are approved and ready for installation.



2. Project Tracking & Progress

Monitor projects from sales/contract handoff through completion.

Keep track of where every project stands and what needs to happen next.

Follow up with customers, contractors, vendors, cities, and utilities.

Identify stalled projects and take action to move them forward.

Maintain accurate project records, spreadsheets, and/or project management software.

Track important deadlines, documents, inspections, and approvals.

Make sure no project or task falls through the cracks.



3. Meter & Inspection Scheduling

Schedule required building/electrical/solar inspections.

Coordinate meter spot/site visits when required.

Coordinate inspection schedules with homeowners and field crews.

Track inspection results and arrange re-inspections when necessary.

Follow up until inspections are successfully completed.

Coordinate with utilities regarding meter installation or replacement.



4. Utility Interconnection

Prepare and submit utility interconnection applications.

Track applications from submission through approval.

Communicate with utilities regarding application requirements, corrections, and missing documents.

Follow up regularly on pending applications.

Coordinate utility meter work when applicable.

Track projects through Permission to Operate (PTO).



QUALIFICATIONS

Previous solar project management experience is strongly preferred.

Experience with California solar permitting and utility interconnection is highly preferred.

Familiarity with cities/counties, AHJs, inspections, and utility processes.

Excellent organizational and follow-up skills.

Strong written and spoken English.

Comfortable communicating professionally through email and phone.

Able to manage multiple projects at the same time.

Extremely detail-oriented.

Proactive and able to work independently.

Comfortable using spreadsheets, email, online permitting portals, and project management software.

Must have a reliable internet connection and be available during U.S. business hours.



THE TYPE OF PERSON WE ARE LOOKING FOR



We need someone who doesn't simply wait for instructions.



The ideal candidate should be able to look at a project and ask:



“Where is this project right now? What is holding it up? What needs to happen next? Who do I need to contact? And when should I follow up again?”



You will be responsible for keeping projects moving and making sure deadlines, applications, inspections, and utility requirements are followed up on.



You should be comfortable making phone calls, sending follow-up emails, checking application portals, coordinating schedules, and communicating with different parties to get projects completed.



COMPENSATION & EMPLOYMENT



$7–$9 USD per hour, depending on experience and qualifications.



This is initially a 3-month temporary position. However, there is an opportunity for the position to become full-time and long-term if you perform well, demonstrate reliability, and are a good fit for our company.



HOW TO APPLY



Please send us:



* Your resume or work history.

* A brief description of your previous solar project management experience.

* Which California utilities and permitting jurisdictions you have worked with.

* Your expected hourly rate ($7–$9/hour).



IMPORTANT: Please make sure all of the requested information is included in your application. Applications that do not provide the requested details will not be considered.

title: Video Research & Clip Sourcing VA for a Fragrance Brand

## What you’ll do

- Find the original source and check what is actually said.

Our ads run in multiple languages. You’ll work in English and prioritise footage without embedded subtitles where possible.

- Strong online research skills, especially on TikTok, Instagram and YouTube.

- Good written English and attention to detail.

- An understanding of what makes an opening clip interesting.

- Ability to trace reposted clips back to their original source.

- Organised, reliable and comfortable following a clear SOP.

- Willingness to flag uncertainty instead of guessing.



Experience researching footage for ecommerce ads is a plus. An interest in fragrances is helpful but not required.



## What we provide



- Clear briefs and video examples.

- A step-by-step SOP.

- Access to our existing product footage.

- Feedback from our team and video editor.



We’ll start with a **small paid trial project**, with the opportunity for ongoing work if we’re a good fit.



## How to apply



Please send:



1. A short introduction and any relevant research or VA experience.

2. One example of a research or sourcing task you’ve completed.

We value useful, well-organised clips with reliable sources—not large folders of random downloads.

title: AutoCAD Draftsman — German Architectural Floor Plans (metric / DIN standards), ongoing work
description:
We are a German drafting service and we are looking for an AutoCAD draftsman to produce architectural floor plans to German standards, on an ongoing basis.



This is not a one-off gig. We want to build a working relationship with one or two reliable people and send work their way continuously as our order volume grows.



What we do



We prepare CAD drawings for private clients, architects and planning offices in Germany. We handle the client, the site information and the full specification. You do the drawing.



A typical job: a client gives us a hand sketch, a survey, an existing plan or a set of measurements of a house. We turn that into a complete, dimensioned specification. You turn our specification into a clean DWG and a print-ready PDF that looks like it came out of a German architecture office.



Typical projects are detached houses, bungalows, apartments and small commercial units, usually 80 – 250 m², ground floor plans and occasionally upper floors. Scale 1:100 or 1:50, sheets DIN A3 or A2.



What the work involves

- Floor plans (Grundriss) — walls, openings, dimension chains, room stamps, furniture

- Occasionally as-built drawings from measured surveys

- Occasionally sections and elevations

- Always 2D. We do not need 3D modelling, rendering or visualisation.



Deliverables for every job:



- .dwg in AutoCAD 2018 format — drawn 1:1 in metres in model space, purged and audited, no xrefs, no proxy objects, nothing on layer 0, dimensions as real dimension objects and never exploded into lines and text

- .pdf — vector, true to scale, monochrome, with line weights plotted

- A short room schedule as a spreadsheet



What you need to be able to do



1. Work entirely in metric. Metres and centimetres. If your drafting experience is in feet and inches, this job is not for you — please do not apply.



2. Work to German drawing conventions. They differ from US and UK practice in specific ways. The most important ones:



- Dimension lines are terminated with a 45° oblique tick, never with an arrowhead

- The decimal separator is a comma: 3,99 — never 3.99

- Dimension text sits above the line, in metres with two decimals, readable from the bottom and from the right

- Dimension chains run in three parallel rows per façade, ordered from the building outwards: openings, then walls and rooms, then the overall dimension — and every chain has to close exactly

- Differentiated line weights: 0,50 mm for cut walls, 0,35 mm for visible edges, 0,25 mm for dimension lines, 0,13 – 0,18 mm for hatching. A drawing where every line has the same weight is not acceptable.

- 45° hatching on cut masonry, at a spacing that actually reads on the printed sheet

- A disciplined layer structure, everything set to ByLayer

- Text in a TrueType font so that German characters (ä ö ü ß) render correctly



You do not need to know these conventions by heart. We supply a written brief of about 6.000 words in English that specifies every one of them: layer names, line weights, text heights, dimension style settings, hatch patterns, title block content and a final self-check list. But you need to be the kind of drafter who can follow a specification to the millimetre. That is the core of this job.



3. Draw clean geometry. Closed polylines, no gaps at wall junctions, no duplicate lines, no overshoots. We check this.



4. Communicate in written English. You do not need to speak German. All German text that appears on the drawing — room names, notes, title block — is supplied as ready-to-copy strings.



What you get from us



We do not send vague requests. Before you start a job you receive:



1. The full written brief with every drawing convention specified

2. A dimensionally verified schematic from us — every dimension chain already closed, with a door schedule and a window schedule giving the exact position of every opening from a defined origin point, and the furniture layout with sizes

3. All site information



There are no design decisions for you to make and nothing to guess. If something in our package is ambiguous, you ask and we answer — that is on us, not on you.



How we start



The first assignment is a small paid test task of about two hours — one band of rooms with walls, openings, one dimension chain and one room stamp. Paid at your normal rate. It tells both of us within a day whether the conventions work out, before either side commits to a full project.



After that, the first full project is roughly 15 hours of work.



On volume, honestly: we are a young business and growing. We are not going to promise you a guaranteed number of hours every week, because we cannot. What we can say is that we intend to send every suitable job to the same person, and that we pay on time, every time.



Please do NOT apply if

- You work primarily in feet and inches

- Your portfolio is renderings, 3D models and visualisations rather than dimensioned working drawings

- You cannot show work you have drawn yourself

- You need a guaranteed full-time workload right now



A straight "this is not my kind of work" costs you nothing and we will remember you positively.



HOW TO APPLY — please read, this d
 it



1. Start your message with the word MASSKETTE. It is German for "dimension chain". It tells us you read the post rather than mass-applying. Applications without it are not read.



2. Attach one or two PDFs of dimensioned floor plans you have drawn yourself. Not renderings. Not 3D views. Working drawings with dimension chains, room labels and a title block. This is by far the most important part of your application — it tells us more than any description.



We will look at exactly these things in your sample:



- Do the dimension chains close, and are they complete?

- Are the line weights differentiated, or is everything one weight?

- Is the drawing in metric?

- Is the layer structure clean?

- Does the sheet look finished — title block, legend, north arrow, room stamps?



3. Answer these four questions, briefly:



a) Which countries' standards have you drawn to? If you have worked on German, Austrian, Swiss or other European projects, say so and say which office or client — that moves you to the front of the queue.



b) What is your hourly rate for this work, and roughly how many hours would you estimate for a furnished 150 m² single-storey floor plan at 1:100 on A3?



c) What does your capacity look like right now — how many hours per day, and which days?



d) Which CAD software do you own and use? (AutoCAD, BricsCAD, Revit, ArchiCAD — tell us the actual version.)



4. If you have a current project running and could start within the next few days, say so. We have work waiting right now.



Thank you for reading this far. We know it is a long post — that is deliberate. We would rather have five applications from people who fit than fifty from people who do not.



Sander Marquardt Zeichenpartner, Germany
